The role supports customers across commercial, public sector, and education segments and must understand how customer-specific requirements can affect licensing execution, documentation, compliance, and service delivery.
  
  
A key focus of the role is establishing and maintaining strong operational controls. This includes partnering with Microsoft and internal compliance teams, monitoring adherence to program and contractual requirements, maintaining audit readiness, and ensuring compliance requirements are consistently applied throughout each transaction.
  
  
The successful candidate will bring strong operational judgment, licensing knowledge, and a continuous-improvement mindset. They will strengthen the business through disciplined execution, clear accountability, effective controls, and thoughtful improvements to processes and tools.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* People Leadership and Team Development
* Lead, coach, develop, and retain a high-performing Microsoft Operations team.
* Establish clear objectives, expectations, and accountabilities aligned with department and business priorities.
* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance discussions, development planning, and objective monitoring.
* Build team capability through coaching, cross-training, knowledge sharing, and succession planning.
* Ensure employees understand the Microsoft program requirements and internal controls applicable to their work.
* Manage staffing, workload allocation, scheduling, and coverage to support business volumes and service commitments.
* Foster a collaborative environment grounded in ownership, accuracy, continuous learning, and customer focus.
* Act as an escalation point for complex operational, customer, compliance, and people-related matters.
* Operational Leadership and Execution
* Lead the day-to-day execution of Microsoft licensing operations across quoting, contracting, ordering, amendments, renewals, and ongoing agreement maintenance.
* Ensure transactions are completed accurately, on time, and in accordance with Microsoft requirements, customer commitments, and internal standards.
* Establish clear priorities, workflows, ownership, and escalation paths across the business.
* Monitor operational performance through scorecards, service levels, productivity measures, quality results, and other relevant indicators.
* Identify trends, capacity risks, process gaps, and recurring issues, and ensure appropriate corrective action is taken.

* Maintain effective business rhythms that give leadership and stakeholders appropriate visibility into performance, risk, and required decisions.
* Microsoft Program and Transaction Compliance
* Partner with Microsoft to understand changes to licensing programs, operational requirements, transaction rules, and partner obligations.
* Translate Microsoft requirements into clear internal procedures, controls, training, and operational practices.
* Ensure Microsoft compliance requirements are maintained throughout the transaction lifecycle.
* Partner with internal Compliance, Legal, Finance, Sales, and other teams to establish and manage controls that support both partner and organizational obligations.
* Maintain appropriate transaction documentation and evidence to support internal reviews, Microsoft assessments, audits, and other compliance activities.
* Conduct or oversee periodic reviews of transactions, processes, and controls to identify gaps and confirm adherence to established requirements.
* Ensure compliance findings, transaction exceptions, and control failures are documented, escalated, remediated, and monitored through completion.
* Promote a culture in which compliance is embedded into daily operations rather than treated as a separate review after the transaction is complete.
* Maintain current knowledge of Microsoft program requirements, contractual obligations, and relevant internal policies.
* Operational Excellence and Continuous Improvement
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, eliminate unnecessary steps, improve quality, and reduce operational risk.
* Lead practical improvements to workflows, documentation, controls, reporting, and supporting tools.
* Use operational data, quality findings, audit results, and employee and stakeholder feedback to prioritize improvements.
* Partner with IT and operational improvement teams to define business requirements and support changes to systems and tools.
* Ensure process or system changes are tested, documented, communicated, and adopted effectively.
* Support automation where it improves accuracy, control, capacity, or customer experience without weakening operational oversight.
* Establish sustainable standard operating procedures and ensure they remain current as Microsoft requirements and internal business needs evolve.
* Measure the effectiveness of implemented improvements and adjust when expected outcomes are not achieved.
* Cross-Functional Partnership and Stakeholder Management
* Build effective working relationships with Microsoft and internal stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Compliance, IT, Enablement, and other business areas.
* Serve as a key operational contact for Microsoft on volume licensing execution, program changes, compliance matters, and escalations.
* Develop and maintain an understanding of the operational, contractual, documentation, and compliance considerations that may apply when supporting public sector and education business.
* Ensure new Microsoft requirements and internal business changes are evaluated for operational impact before implementation.
* Clarify roles, responsibilities, handoffs, and escalation paths across teams involved in the licensing transaction lifecycle.
* Provide clear, fact-based updates to senior leaders regarding operational performance, business risks, compliance matters, and improvement priorities.
* Educate internal stakeholders on operational requirements and the information needed to support accurate and compliant execution.
* Balance customer and business needs with Microsoft program requirements, contractual obligations, and operational controls, including the distinct requirements that may apply to public sector and education customers.
* Governance, Risk, and Business Management
* Identify operational, compliance, financial, and customer risks within the processes managed by Microsoft Licensing Operations.
* Establish mitigation plans, monitor corrective actions, and escalate material risks appropriately.
* Maintain operational scorecards and reporting that provide visibility into service levels, quality, productivity, compliance, and improvement progress.
* Oversee process documentation, control ownership, decision records, and audit evidence within the team's scope.
* Contribute to operational planning, capacity planning, technology roadmaps, and business cases for process or system investment.
* Ensure changes to programs, processes, or systems have clear ownership, documentation, controls, training, and implementation plans.
* Provide functional guidance to internal teams on how Microsoft Licensing Operations integrates with their business processes and customer responsibilities.

**What You Will Bring To The Table**

* At least three years of progressive experience in licensing operations, customer operations, sales operations, or a related technology environment.
* Demonstrated people-leadership experience, including coaching, performance management, talent development, and workload planning.
* Strong experience managing complex, high-volume, transaction-based operations.
* Practical knowledge of software licensing, contract processing, quoting, ordering, renewals, and agreement maintenance.
* Experience interpreting external program or partner requirements and translating them into internal processes and controls.
* Experience supporting compliance reviews, audits, operational controls, or risk-management activities.

Title: Manager, Operations Integration Subways
Description:
**Job Description**
Metrolinx is connecting communities across the Greater Golden Horseshoe. Metrolinx operates GO Transit and UP Express, as well as the PRESTO fare payment system. We are also building new and improved rapid transit, including GO Expansion, Light Rail Transit routes, and major expansions to Toronto’s subway system, to get people where they need to go, better, faster and easier. Metrolinx is an agency of the Government of Ontario.
  
  
At Metrolinx, equity, diversity and inclusion are essential to living our values of serving with passion, thinking forward and playing as a team.
  
  
The Manager, Operations Integration – Subways plays a key role in ensuring the safe, reliable and efficient delivery of subway and LRT services. The position provides operational, technical and functional oversight of operator, maintainer and project agreements across the subway and LRT programs, supporting high-quality, customer-focused transportation services that are safe, timely and delivered in accordance with contractual requirements.
  
  
**What will I be doing?**

* Oversee the planning, coordination and delivery of subway and LRT services, ensuring safe, effective and efficient customer movement, service levels, schedules and operational plans align with Metrolinx strategies and organizational objectives.
* Manage operator, contractor and maintainer performance against service level plans, contractual obligations and KPIs; identify non-compliance, implement mitigation and corrective action strategies, and ensure quality assurance and continuous service improvement.
* Lead the development, implementation and monitoring of operational plans, management programs, policies, procedures, workflows, SOPs and performance measures in consultation with internal and external stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable safety, regulatory, legal and contractual requirements through audits, monitoring, risk assessments and engagement with regulatory bodies, while incorporating industry best practices and emerging issues.
* Prepare and deliver executive-level reports, presentations and operational studies outlining service performance, KPIs, strategic directions, findings and improvement initiatives to Metrolinx leadership and external stakeholders.
* Coordinate operational activities across Metrolinx departments and business units, providing transportation expertise and input into major service improvement projects, service extensions, operational planning and negotiations with internal partners.
* Represent Metrolinx on contractual, operational and transportation development matters with service providers, contractors, consultants, industry associations, government representatives and other external partners.
* Build and maintain effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders, partners, vendors and government representatives through ongoing communication, consultation, negotiation and issue resolution.
* Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement by researching, recommending and implementing new or revised standards, specifications, processes and procedures that enhance efficiency, customer service, design standards and safety.
* Manage departmental activities, service delivery objectives and budgetary requirements while providing leadership, guidance and constructive feedback to contractors, consultants and partners, ensuring appropriate resources, capabilities, performance standards and positive working relationships.

**What Skills and Qualifications Do I Need?**

* Completion of a degree in Business, Engineering or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
* Demonstrated years' of progressively responsible experience in the transportation and/or public transit sector, including leadership of frontline staff and/or project management, ideally within the public sector.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is considered an asset. A Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation is also an asset but not required.
* Demonstrated leadership and interpersonal competencies, including service-focused and transformational leadership, effective communication, sound decision-making, delivering results, building high-performance cultures, energizing teams, personal effectiveness and alignment with organizational values.
* Knowledge of applicable Human Resources legislation, including the Employment Standards Act and Occupational Health and Safety Act, as well as railway operating rules and legislation governing railway, environmental, public and employee safety.
* Strong knowledge of transportation, engineering and planning, including commuter rapid transit (subway, LRT and BRT) system planning, design and delivery, maintenance facilities, stations, storage yards and related infrastructure.
* Understanding of transit system functional requirements and technical components, including signalling and train control, SCADA, communications, trackwork, vehicle and wayside interfaces, traction power, power supply and distribution, mechanical systems, system and train simulation, tunnels, and fire and life safety systems.
* Knowledge of System Safety Certification processes and the ability to identify technical inadequacies, evaluate plans and apply appropriate rail transportation analytical tools.
* Demonstrated experience managing, mentoring and developing employees and contractors, applying collective agreement provisions, overseeing vendors and externally provided services, monitoring contractual performance, and understanding IT capabilities and budget planning and monitoring processes.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint), with strong written, verbal, interpersonal and presentation skills, including the ability to prepare reports and communicate operational studies, findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.

***This role requires the successful candidate to be at the office, f**
**ive days per week, with regular travel throughout the Toronto area (at least twice weekly), availability outside regular business hours to maintain relationships and address operational issues, and site visits to transit operating environments, including train facilities and above- and below-grade track alignments. Personal protective equipment (PPE) is required at worksites.***

Please review all provisions of the policy before submitting your application.

Title: Senior Staff Portfolio Operations Manager
Description:
**Hi there! Thanks for stopping by**

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

Lightspeed is seeking a **Senior Staff Portfolio Operations Manager** to join our Product & Technology Operations team.

In this role, you'll help Product & Technology leaders understand portfolio performance, investment priorities, and business outcomes. Using data and business insights, you'll support informed decision-making around priorities, investments, and strategic trade-offs.

The role will begin with a six-month assignment leading Product Operations for our Hospitality vertical. During this time, you'll partner with Product & Technology leaders to support roadmap development and execution, manage cross-functional dependencies, and strengthen planning and delivery practices. Following this initial assignment, you'll transition into a permanent, cross-portfolio Business Operations role spanning Hospitality, Retail, and Financial Services.

Reporting to the Director of Business Operations, Product & Technology, you'll collaborate closely with Product Operations leads, vertical leaders, Finance, and other cross-functional partners.

This is a **senior individual contributor** role suited to someone who brings experience in software product development, strong business judgment, and the ability to influence senior leaders, challenge assumptions, and drive change without relying on formal authority.

**Location:** Lightspeed is currently seeking **candidates based in Canada**. Candidates in Canada but residing outside the Eastern Time Zone must be flexible and willing to adjust their working hours as needed to accommodate EST-based collaboration and business requirements.

**What you'll be doing:**

* **Lead Hospitality Product Operations**

  + Lead Product Operations for Hospitality during the initial six-month assignment, establishing the ways of working needed to support effective product development and delivery.
  + Partner with Hospitality Product & Technology leaders on roadmap planning and execution, managing priorities, dependencies, and delivery risks.
  + Establish planning and reporting cadences that provide visibility into progress, emerging issues, and decisions required.
  + Identify opportunities to improve how teams plan, communicate, and execute against priorities, breaking down silos and strengthening cross-functional collaboration.
  + Lead special projects and operational improvements aligned with evolving business needs and leadership priorities.
* **Drive Portfolio Performance & Investment Decisions**

  + Lead portfolio reviews across Hospitality, Retail, and Financial Services, providing visibility into priorities, investments, delivery progress, and business outcomes.
  + Develop reporting and dashboards to assess investment performance, identify gaps, and highlight areas requiring attention.
  + Analyze results and root causes to understand performance against expectations and identify opportunities for improvement.
  + Recommend changes to priorities and investments, helping leaders evaluate trade-offs and determine where to continue, adjust, or deprioritize work.
  + Partner with Finance, Product Operations, and Product & Technology leaders to challenge assumptions, inform investment decisions, and drive accountability.
* **Strengthen Cross-Portfolio Planning & Decision Making**

  + Help leaders assess priorities and trade-offs across Hospitality, Retail, and Financial Services, identifying competing demands and opportunities.
  + Maintain visibility into roadmaps across all three verticals, identifying dependencies, risks, and broader portfolio implications.
  + Partner with Product Operations leads and vertical leaders to resolve shared challenges, build alignment, and coordinate action.
  + Establish consistent planning and review processes that support collaboration and timely decision-making.
  + Prepare leadership recommendations that connect portfolio performance and priorities to broader business objectives, tracking decisions and actions through to completion.
* **Improve Cross-Portfolio Ways of Working & GTM Alignment**

  + Establish consistent go-to-market handoff processes across Hospitality, Retail, and Financial Services while accommodating each vertical's needs.
  + Strengthen communication between Product and GTM teams throughout the product lifecycle, ensuring upcoming features, launches, and roadmap changes are clearly communicated.
  + Create feedback loops that bring market insights, customer feedback, and GTM learnings back to Product teams to inform roadmap planning and prioritization.
  + Improve visibility into launch readiness, cross-functional dependencies, and ownership to identify and resolve gaps before they impact execution.

**What you'll need to bring:**

* Significant experience in SaaS product development, Product Operations, Business Operations, or a related field, with a strong understanding of product development lifecycles, roadmap planning, and execution.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex programs or portfolios, including prioritization, resource allocation, cross-functional dependencies, risks, and business outcomes across multiple teams.
* Strong analytical and financial acumen, with experience developing portfolio reporting, dashboards, financial models, and investment tracking to support business decisions and evaluate trade-offs.
* Proven ability to translate complex data and business performance insights into actionable recommendations that inform strategic priorities, investment decisions, and operational improvements.
* Experience partnering with and influencing senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, building alignment, challenging assumptions, and driving decisions without relying on formal authority.
* Strong business judgment and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently identify opportunities, anticipate challenges, and drive initiatives forward in ambiguous environments.
* Experience improving operational processes, governance, and ways of working within a complex technology organization, balancing strategic priorities with hands-on execution.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts, adapt messaging to different audiences, and build trusted relationships across Product, Technology, Finance, and other business functions.
* A collaborative and empathetic approach, with the ability to understand different team perspectives, navigate competing priorities, and develop practical solutions that drive meaningful business outcomes.

Title: Senior Technology Program Manager
Description:
**Who are we?**
Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
  
  
A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
  
  
A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We're looking for a Senior Staff Technical Program Manager to join Equinix's Digital and Innovation Office. This is a senior individual contributor role for an experienced program manager who has spent years running complex, multi-team programs and knows how to get things done across organizational boundaries with limited oversight.
  
  
You'll lead complex, high-priority, cross-functional programs end to end, work across technical and business teams, and help shape how program management is practiced across DIO. You will also mentor other junior project and program managers within the PMO.
  
  
Critically, we're looking for someone who is actively curious about how AI tools can make program management faster, more thorough, and more scalable and who can put that curiosity to practical use.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Project, Program, & Portfolio Execution
  
  

* Own, shape, and drive complex, cross-functional technology programs through the full technology development lifecycle (scope, schedule, change, risk, procurement, vendor, and closure)
* Assess and recommend the right delivery approach (Agile, Waterfall, hybrid, SAFe) based on program needs
* Manage multiple workstreams, risks and inter-dependencies, budgets, and timelines simultaneously in collaboration with other program/portfolio managers, if applicable
* Proactively identify and resolve blockers at the program level, including issues that cut across teams or organizations
* Lead effort estimation, resource planning, and capacity alignment with senior stakeholders
* Conduct structured retrospectives and translate learnings into lasting process improvements

Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Build working relationships with senior leaders, directors, and VP-level stakeholders across technical and business functions ensuring alignment and business readiness
* Define and publish communication plans, facilitate decision making and resolve cross-team conflicts before they become program risks
* Lead or support steering committees, program reviews, and executive briefings
* Leverage concise, sharp, and executive-ready content to convey current state of affairs and drive required outcomes

Governance & Reporting
  
  

* Effectively and proactively monitor and report program progress and health, milestones, risks and mitigation, scope changes, resource needs and decisions
* Create and use JIRA or other tool-based dashboards to visualize program related data
* Ensure compliance with internal controls, standards, and documentation practices
* Support vendor management and third-party integrations, where applicable
* Track and report financial data, program metrics, and operational effectiveness

Agile Delivery & Facilitation
  
  

* Use your strong command over multiple PM methodologies (Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Waterfall, Kanban) to determine the best approach for a given program and apply them correctly
* Lead 3-5 agile teams as an RTE (release train engineer)
* Coach teams on Agile best practices and metrics (velocity, burndown, backlog health,) using Jira/Confluence
* Facilitate scrum of scrums and structure work delivery across Agile Release Trains (ARTs) through ART ceremonies (PI Planning, ART Sync, PO Sync, System Demo)
* Use data analysis and modelling to uncover insights and support decision-making

AI Enablement and PM Innovation
  
  

* Actively use AI tools to accelerate program work status reporting, risk synthesis, documentation, meeting prep, and more
* Able to evaluate practical opportunities and apply lightweight AI-powered solutions to day to day program management workflows without requiring engineering support
* Help scale program management bandwidth by mentoring and enabling other PMs and teams to leverage AI effectively
* Stay current on relevant AI and other tooling improvements and share what's working with the broader TPM community
* Define and document PM standards, templates, and processes that others can use and build on

**Qualifications**
Experience
  
  

* 12+ years of technical program or project management experience with a demonstrated track record running large, complex programs with multiple teams and external dependencies
* Previous data center experience highly preferred
* Specific exposure to following in an enterprise environment is highly desirable
* Engineering excellence domains: SRE, developer experience, building and scaling engineering platforms, DevSecOps, software quality management practices
* Data center operations domains: Energy and sustainability, design and construction, digital twins, infrastructure monitoring, capacity planning
* Skilled at navigating ambiguity and driving clarity in complex, matrixed environments
* Excellent communicator (both written and verbal) and collaborator with a practical, outcomes-driven mindset that appeals to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Practical, hands-on experience with tools such as Miro, Jira, Confluence, MS 365 suite, Smartsheet, or equivalent

* One or more relevant certifications required: PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, SAFe RTE, SAFe Program Consultant, or equivalent
* Additional certifications in AI/ML fundamentals or digital transformation are a plus

Title: Senior ERP Transformation & D365 Programme Assurance Lead

This is a senior, hands-on role requiring a professional who combines strong ERP programme management capabilities with practical Microsoft Dynamics 365 implementation experience.

The individual must be capable of independently assessing the implementation partner's deliverables, identifying risks, challenging solution designs, monitoring project execution and ensuring the programme meets the client's business, technical, security and operational requirements.

* Take overall responsibility for client-side governance, monitoring and assurance of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 ERP implementation.

* Manage implementation schedules, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, issues and contractual obligations.
* Oversee implementation partner performance and validate progress against agreed scope, quality standards and delivery commitments.
* Review and challenge functional and technical solution designs to ensure alignment with business requirements and recognised industry practices.
* Conduct fit-gap assessments and validate Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance, Supply Chain Management and Project Operations configurations.

* Review business requirements, process mapping, functional specifications and solution architecture.

* Coordinate organisational change activities, including stakeholder engagement, business impact assessment, role mapping, communications and training.

* Identify programme risks, technical weaknesses, delivery gaps and potential non-compliance with agreed requirements.

* Prepare executive dashboards, progress reports, risk assessments and technical assurance findings.

* Support issue resolution, change control, contractual discussions and corrective action planning.
* Ensure the ERP solution is appropriately tested, secured, documented and operationally ready for successful deployment.

ERP Programme Management & Governance

* Demonstrated experience managing SIT, UAT, defect governance and integrated ERP testing.

* Knowledge of organisational change management, role mapping, training design and user adoption.

* Knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Power Platform and enterprise application integration.

Desirable Experience

* Familiarity with public-sector finance, procurement, supply chain and project accounting requirements.

Title: General Manager
Description:
Tahreez Sport & Entertainment (TSE) is a joint venture between Tahreez and PMY Group, combining Tahreez’s strong Saudi foundation, operational capabilities, and market insight with PMY’s globally recognised expertise in live environment technologies and major event delivery.

Together, TSE delivers integrated venue technologies and operational solutions that enhance safety, efficiency, and audience experiences across stadiums, arenas, and live entertainment environments throughout Saudi Arabia.

Combining deep local insight with decades of global experience, TSE provides end-to-end capabilities across strategy, consulting, design, implementation, operations, software, data intelligence, and live experience technologies.

Backed by more than 500 professionals, over 1,000 clients across 15 countries, and more than 40 years of combined industry expertise, TSE is uniquely positioned to deliver world-class venue and event technology solutions tailored to the Saudi market.

United by a shared commitment to innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence, Tahreez and PMY work together to create connected, future-ready live environments — delivering invisible technology with visible impact.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

The General Manager – TSE will be responsible for growing and leading Tahreez Sports & Entertainment's business and operations across the Kingdom.

The role requires a commercially driven and entrepreneurial leader with a strong understanding of the Saudi market, capable of developing client relationships, converting opportunities into profitable revenue, and building and managing a growing organisation.

Working closely with the leadership of PMY Group and Tahreez, the General Manager will bring rigour, commitment and accountability to the execution of the business plan, ensuring operational excellence, financial discipline and sustainable growth.

The role will be instrumental in establishing the JV as a trusted advisor and delivery partner across sport, entertainment, venues, major events, technology and infrastructure in Saudi Arabia.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Strategic Leadership & Growth**

* Develop and execute the Saudi Arabia growth strategy aligned to the objectives of both PMY Group and Tahreez.
* Identify emerging market opportunities, strategic sectors, and priority clients to support long-term growth.
* Provide leadership and direction to ensure sustainable and profitable business expansion.

**Business Development & Client Relationships**

* Lead the pursuit and conversion of new business opportunities across sports, entertainment, venues, events, technology, and infrastructure sectors.
* Build and maintain executive-level relationships with clients, government entities, developers, venue operators, event owners, partners, and industry stakeholders.
* Support bid strategy, negotiations, commercial discussions, and contract execution.

**Operational Leadership**

* Oversee the successful establishment and operation of the Saudi business, ensuring appropriate governance, processes and controls are in place in alignment with Tahreez and PMY Group.
* Provide executive oversight of project delivery performance, client satisfaction, resource planning, and operational effectiveness.

**Financial Performance**

* Own the Saudi Arabia business plan, revenue targets, profitability objectives, budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance.
* Monitor business performance and implement actions to achieve growth and margin targets.
* Ensure commercial discipline, risk management, and strong financial governance across all activities.

**Joint Venture Leadership**

* Maintain a collaborative and effective partnership between PMY Group and Tahreez.
* Ensure strategic alignment between both organisations while balancing commercial, operational, and cultural objectives.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders from both JV partners.
* Support the implementation of agreed governance frameworks and reporting requirements.

**People & Culture**

* Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Saudi-based team as the business grows.
* Create a culture aligned with the values and behaviours of both PMY Group and Tahreez.
* Provide mentoring, coaching, and leadership development to employees.
* Drive employee engagement, accountability, and performance excellence.

**Stakeholder & Government Engagement**

* Develop strong relationships with key government authorities, regulatory bodies, strategic partners, and industry leaders.
* Maintain awareness of market developments, regulatory requirements, and strategic initiatives relevant to the business.
* Act as the primary representative and spokesperson for the Joint Venture within the Kingdom.
* Contribute to maintaining a safe and healthy workplace in accordance with company Occupational Health and Safety policies, operational standards, and relevant legislative requirements.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

* Significant senior leadership experience within Saudi Arabia or the GCC region.
* Demonstrated experience establishing, leading, or scaling a growing business operation.
* Strong commercial acumen with proven business development and client relationship management capability.
* Experience working across sports, entertainment, venues, major events, technology, infrastructure, construction, or related sectors.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage senior executives, government representatives, and strategic partners.
* Proven financial management and P&L leadership experience.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate effectively in a high-growth environment.
* Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and people management skills.
* Cultural awareness and ability to operate successfully within a joint venture environment.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business, Engineering, Construction, Technology, Sports Management, or a related discipline.

**WHY TAHREEZ SPORTS AND ENTERTAINMENT?**

* **Shape the Future** Be part of a company bringing world-class venue and live environment technologies into Saudi Arabia across sports, entertainment, and major destinations.
* **Create Real Impact** Contribute to delivering intelligent technologies that enhance safety, operational efficiency, connectivity, and audience experience across the Kingdom.
* **Work Alongside Experts** Collaborate with industry professionals and global specialists across venue technologies, integrated systems, operations, and live event environments.
* **Grow With Purpose** Build your career in a dynamic sector that encourages continuous learning, professional growth, and hands-on experience on ambitious projects.
* **Be Part of Something Bigger** As a strategic joint venture between Tahreez and PMY Group, TSE combines global innovation with strong Saudi operational capability to deliver intelligent solutions with real impact.

### **Company Overview**

TRANSFORMING THROUGH TECHNOLOGY - PMY Group is a full-service technology solutions company that supports venues and major events to enhance their infrastructure, experience, and intelligence. We specialise in providing cutting-edge AI, data, and cloud solutions to sports, media, and entertainment sectors, helping them achieve their full potential through the transformative power of data and AI.

Title: Senior Director - Roads and Mobility - AG6
Description:
Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Senior Director - Roads and Mobility to lead the strategy, operational governance and lifecycle performance of Qiddiya City's roads, bridges, tunnels and associated infrastructure, including Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS).
  
  
As the accountable asset owner, you will establish the standards, operating model and investment priorities needed to deliver a safe, reliable and resilient road network. Working closely with development teams, transport operators and relevant authorities, you will oversee operational readiness, maintenance and service-provider performance, supporting everyday city operations, phased openings and major events.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**

* Define and deliver the roads and mobility asset strategy, operating model and long-term plans
* Lead lifecycle management, inspection, maintenance and renewal planning across roads, bridges, tunnels and associated infrastructure
* Set the ITS strategy, overseeing system availability, network monitoring and integration with city command-and-control platforms
* Lead asset-owner input into design, commissioning and handover, ensuring maintainability and operational readiness
* Oversee budgets, procurement requirements and service providers, driving safety, quality, performance and value
* Coordinate network operating plans, roadworks, closures and incident-response arrangements with authorities and operational stakeholders
* Lead multidisciplinary teams and establish performance reporting covering asset condition, network availability, risks and investment priorities

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering or a related engineering discipline; a relevant master's degree is preferred
* Typically 15+ years of relevant experience in roads, transport infrastructure or network asset management
* At least 5 years in senior leadership, accountable for significant asset portfolios, budgets and multidisciplinary teams
* Demonstrated asset-owner or client-side leadership across road networks, bridges and tunnels, including maintenance and renewal programmes
* Strong experience in ITS oversight, operational handover, outsourced service delivery and coordination with authorities and transport operators
* Strong capability in risk-based asset management, lifecycle investment and stakeholder leadership; professional registration and major-event or regional experience are advantageous.

Title: Director of IT
Location: Toronto, Ontario, Canada | Toronto, ON, Canada
Description:
Guru Studio is a creative-driven entertainment company and an industry leader in animated storytelling. For over twenty years, our studio has brought to life some of the most recognizable and beloved children’s properties in the world.
  
  
We’re always looking for passionate and committed talent, so come join our dynamic and growing team!
  
  
Guru is proud to offer our team members meaningful learning and developmental opportunities! You will work alongside a wide range of talent in a positive and supportive environment where we want to see success in each individual.
  
  
We're looking for a talented and experienced Director of IT - come join our team!
  
  
The Director of IT will supervise and manage the IT department’s daily and long-term operations to allow for growth in a fast paced and rapidly expanding internationally renowned animation studio. This role is a management position for a very sophisticated tech-based company and requires clear and effective leadership and visionary thinking. This role reports to the VP of Technology.
  
  
Duties and Responsibilities:
  
  
Management + Supervision
  
  

* Manage a department of IT professionals in their day to day operational functions and all of their responsibilities including server, desktop, and communications infrastructure, ensuring a reasonable level of in-studio IT support is available during regular business hours.
* Set goals and milestones for all IT staff. Review their performance and report to the VP of Technology.
* Liaise with all heads of production and business operations to ensure IT department’s efforts are coordinated to meet everyone’s needs (get information on studio upcoming projects, determine production resources needs, communication and delivery requirements and issue and follow up on all appropriate tasks).

Facility Infrastructure Planning
  
  

* Ensure all physical services (leased space, electrical, HVAC, floor load etc) at the studio and in the data centre are able to support IT equipment and services and that the equipment is compatible and fully integrated with physical services.
* Manage all budget needs for the IT department: create, present and revise purchase orders, follow up on approvals, ensure purchasing documentation is digitized, recorded and stored in a central repository, maintain IT inventory lists.
* Budget for, acquire and maintain appropriate licenses for all software needed for production and business operations.
* Maintain studio growth plan with the President, the VP of Technology and VP of Finance and Business Affairs.
* Gather and organize purchasing research with guidance from relevant IT personnel.
* Prepare projected equipment cost information for studio project bidding purposes.
* Implement, manage and supervise IT desktop ticketing systems.
* Schedule IT all operations including: personnel, technical maintenance, internal meetings and finance and budget related deadlines.
* Ensure regular maintenance and upgrades are done to all IT infrastructure to ensure a secure and well-functioning IT environment.
* Work with studio stakeholders to implement any studio expansion or move.

Knowledgebase
  
  

* Maintain IT documentation/wiki (oversee, coordinate and arrange information input and creation of diagrams, organize the structure of documentation/wiki, propose new sections).
* Create and Maintain IT procedures and policies (coordinate with the input from the VP of Technology).
* Guru methodology asks for employees who will go above and beyond; in staying informed on upcoming technologies, most cost-effective vendors and taking the initiative in implementing forward thinking planning within each department.

Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 5+ years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure and operations, including 1–2+ years in a senior management or director-level role.
* Previous experience working in an animation, VFX, gaming, or post-production environment is considered a strong asset.
* Deep expertise in enterprise server architecture, high-speed networking, SAN/NAS storage, render farms, cloud/hybrid workflows, and multi-OS environments (Linux, Windows, macOS).
* Strong familiarity with 2D/3D creative software pipelines (e.g., Maya, Houdini, Nuke, Harmony, Adobe Creative Cloud) and managing enterprise software licensing.
* Hands-on experience overseeing physical data center requirements (electrical, HVAC, floor load) and leading studio office expansions or relocations.
* Proven track record managing IT helpdesk ticketing systems, asset inventories, preventative maintenance schedules, and studio security/IP protection standards (such as TPN compliance).
* Extensive experience negotiating vendor contracts, managing purchase orders, and forecasting equipment costs for project bidding.
* Strong organizational skills with experience building and maintaining structured IT wikis, network diagrams, SOPs, and company-wide IT policies.

* We create a collaborative and creatively fulfilling work environment by promoting courage, purpose, inspiration, integrity, transparency, and empowerment as our core values
* We take great pride in our work and we always ensure it reflects a high standard of quality and creativity
* We encourage individuals to grow with us by offering learning opportunities that encourage skill development and growth
* We are proud to support philanthropic initiatives that support our local and global community through our charity committee Guru Gives
* We offer health and wellness support through an extensive benefits plan and extended mental health services and initiatives

Title: Regional Director
Description:
****ABOUT US****
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
BGIS is a leading provider of customized facility management and real estate services. With a combined team of over 10,000 professionals worldwide, we relentlessly focus on enabling innovation through the services we deliver. We actively seek new opportunities that drive innovation for our clients’ businesses. Globally, we manager over 320 million square feet of client portfolios across 30,000+ locations in North America, Europe, Middle East, Australia, and Asia. For further information, visit www.bgis.com .
  
  
**OUR CULTURE**
At BGIS, our culture is built on three foundational pillars:
  
  

* Culture of Care: We deeply care for each other, our clients, partners, and the communities we serve.
* High Performing Teams: We go Above and Beyond to deliver exceptional services. INTEGRITY, OWNERSHIP, RESPONSIVENESS, INITIATION, VISIBILITY, DRIVE, and INTEGRATION are core to high performance.
* Unwavering Commitment to Sustainability: We conduct every action with a focus on preserving our earth.

****SUMMARY****
For the assigned region(s), the
**Regional Director**
is accountable for operations, financial management and meeting service delivery obligations in a specified Geographical region that includes several facilities, employees and clients.  This role is expected to understand, coach and train the team in all regulatory and client requirements.  In addition, this role is also responsible for contributing to strategic and account management plans and objectives and people leadership.
  
  
This role will work in collaboration with all key BGIS departments to ensure full support of all activities and play a key role in our INTEGRATED approach to operating buildings.
  
  
**Opportunities for Development:**
  
  
At BGIS we are committed to the development of our people – offering them opportunities to learn and grow into various roles.  Success in the role offers Team Members the opportunity to explore various roles – some include:
  
  

* On Account and expanded Operational Leadership
* Facility Management Office roles to support accounts,
* Project Management leadership roles to lead and execute projects

****KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES****
**Health, Safety, Environment & Security**
  
  

* Follow and apply all Health and Safety and Emergency Response, aligned with both BGIS and Client expectations.to ensure safety of all employees and building occupants.
* Work in collaboration with BGIS Health Safety and Environment Teams for support and direction on key programs to emphasize Safety Culture
* Accountable for meeting all internal and external health, safety, environment and security-related requirements
* Accountable for the safe delivery of all work performed

**Account Management**
  
  

* Continuously engages clients in discussions to understand and anticipate needs, identify and recommend additional services
* Provides input and contributes to the development and execution of strategic account expansion plans
* Recommends additional pull-through services
* Participates in and contributes to quarterly business reviews
* Contributes to contract renewal and business development activities
* Contributes to account governance
* Adherence to Contract Specific MSA (Master Service Agreement)
* Manages the BGIS ECE Program for the specific client group
* Responsible for results and action plans related to the Likely to Recommend Survey.

**Client Relationship Management**
  
  

* Accountable for achieving client satisfaction objectives for the assigned region(s)
* Accountable for developing and maintaining effective relationships with clients, managing client expectations
* Position level of client representatives with whom this position typically interacts with include those at the senior management level
* Acts as the focal point of escalation for issues pertaining to facilities within assigned region(s)

**Region/Portfolio Budget Development & Management**
  
  

* Assume financial responsibility for facility operations, including budget management.
* In partnership with finance, responsible for the development of budgets (O&M, Transaction, capital projects and rent), and be able to support and explain approach to the client and the account team.
* Using financial reports, perform monthly budget, analyze and re-forecast allocations as necessary.
* Meet annual targets as per contractual performance and client financial targets / indicators.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities and develop strategies to maximize financial resources.
* Track and report on budget positive or negative trends performance regularly
* Participates in, provides recommendations, and contributes to continuous improvement projects to achieve efficiency gains and cost savings

**Portfolio Management**
  
  

* Accountable for operations management for the portfolio of facilities within the assigned region(s)
* Leads the operations and maintenance activities of a portfolio of facilities along with the execution of the portfolio’s programs
* Oversees the completion and submission of capital plans
* Creates and implements short to mid-term plans for the assigned region(s)
* Provides input into strategic plans
* Collaborates with relevant stakeholders to optimize facilities within assigned region(s) and continuously create value for the client.

**Service Delivery Management**
  
  

* Work in collaboration with Central Work Order Management Team to ensure all work is being completed as outlined in the MSA
* Monitor work order progress and ensure tasks are completed within established timelines.
* Work with Account Governance Teams to maintain accurate records of work orders and associated costs.
* Streamline and manage work order processes to optimize efficiency.
* Prioritize and assign work orders based on urgency and impact on facility operations.
* Accountable for meeting all service obligations for the assigned region(s)
* Oversees the delivery of all service obligations
* Accountable for meeting established metrics/key performance indicators.  Leads the operations team in the development and implementation of action plans to remediate gaps, where applicable, to ensure objectives are met.
* Accountable for ensuring compliance to all legislated, corporate and industry-related requirements and guidelines including but not limited to environmental, health and safety, and building standard requirements

**Risk Management, Emergency Preparedness and Business Continuity Planning and Execution**
  
  

* Accountable for safeguarding the client against emergencies and risks by ensuring emergency preparedness, risk management, disaster recovery and business continuity plans are developed and that relevant stakeholders are trained to ensure proper execution
* Oversight and engagement in Emergency Management

**Regulatory Compliance**
  
  

* Accountable for ensuring all regulatory compliance requirements have been met and all related documentation are created and maintained
* Ensure compliance with corporate and legislated policies, procedures, practices and guidelines related to environmental, building code and issues by applying cursory knowledge of legislation related to these areas

**Project Management**
  
  

* Accountable for on-time, on-budget and quality delivery of facility management projects for the assigned region(s)
* Collaborates with clients and internal stakeholders to identify project opportunities and priorities, develop and implement projects
* Oversees the development and execution of project plans for portfolios within assigned region(s)

**Procurement**
  
  

* With Support from BGIS Strategic Sourcing and Vendor Management Leadership – follow BGIS Vendor Performance and Relationship Management Program protocols
* Collaborates with Procurement and Supply Chain Administration teams to source and qualify vendors, source and procure goods and services.

**Continuous Improvement**
  
  

* Collaborates with stakeholders and contributes to efficiency gains   through activities including but not limited to identifying and implementing best practices; reviewing, refining and/or developing, implementing processes, technologies and sustainable practices, and leveraging self-perform wherever possible.  Implements related enhancements for the assigned region(s)

**Leadership and Recognition**
  
  

* Accountable for employee-oriented activities including but not limited to employee engagement, development and performance management, hiring and retention, compensation recommendations
* Employee Satisfaction Scores and employee recognition (development and implementation of action plans to improve ESAT scores)
* Day to day support and team oversight/management

**Collaboration with BGIS Self Perform Teams delivering Best Quality Services to Buildings**
  
  

* Work in collaboration with BGIS teams in Janitorial, Project Management and TechnicalServices or any other areas where work is directly performed by BGIS to maximize efficiency and the best customer service in the buildings / portfolios
* Work together with these teams to ensure work is completed

**Technology to Support your Success.**
  
  

* Leverage technology such as work order system, vendor monitoring tools, BAS and CMMS scheduling tools to deliver effective service to clients.
* Mentor staff in vendor management and the effective use of technology for vendor relationships.
* Provide guidance to team members on the effective use of technology for financial management and career progression.
* Other duties as assigned

****KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS****

* Community college diploma preferably in business administration
* More than 10 years of facility management work experience
* Highly skilled at account management
* Highly skilled at facility operations management
* Highly skilled at client relationship management with demonstrated ability in building and managing relationships with client representatives at the senior management level
* Highly skilled at managing service delivery and meeting service delivery obligations
* Skilled at managing budgets
* Fully developed communication, influence, persuasion and negotiation skills
* High degree of client service orientation and sense of urgency
* Highly skilled at leading and engaging a team of individuals
* Skilled at vendor management
* Highly skilled at emergency management, emergency preparedness and business continuity planning and execution
* Possesses a sustainability mindset and seeks to incorporate sustainable practices within assigned portfolio where possible
* Expert level knowledge of health and safety requirements. Possesses a high degree of safety mindset
* Maintains current knowledge of and highly skilled at implementing facility management services best practices
* Expert level knowledge of current building standards and requirements
* Possesses a continuous improvement and quality mindset along with a desire to continuously seek and incorporate innovative practices and technologies in order to deliver value to the client

**Licenses and/or Professional Accreditation**
One or more of the following would be considered an asset:
  
  

* Certified Facility Manager from International Facility Management Association
* Certified Property Manager from Institute of Real Estate Management
* Facility Management Administrator Designation from Building Owners and Managers Institute
* Real Property Administrator Designation from Building Owners and Managers Institute

This is a regular, full-time position with a salary range of $110,000 - $138,000 per annum. The starting salary will be based on the successful candidate’s competencies, including but not limited to experience, education and performance related to this role.

Upon request for accommodation, we will consult with the applicant in question and provide, or arrange for the provision of, suitable accommodation in a manner that takes into account the applicant’s accessibility needs due to disability.
  
  
****ABOUT US****
We value transparency in our hiring processes. Please note, artificial intelligence may be used in certain stages to screen, assess, or select applicants, however, a human reviewer makes all final decisions. This posting is for a future vacancy.
  
  
****ABOUT THE TEAM****
BGIS is a global leader in integrated facility management services. With a combined team of over 10,000 globally, BGIS relentlessly focuses on delivering innovative service solutions that create value for its clients. Globally, BGIS manages over 50,000 facilities totaling more than 600 million square feet across several markets including government, higher education, utilities, telecommunications, financial services, oil & gas, healthcare and cloud enterprise. In addition to managing a diverse portfolio of corporate offices, retail, colleges, hospitals and industrial assets, BGIS is a world leader in the management of data centers and other critical environments.

Description:

  ------------

  Etobicoke, Ontario, Canada

  Full time

**Role Summary**

The Operations Process & Performance Manager is a senior individual contributor responsible for the operational enablement, support and continuous improvement of systems, standardized processes, performance reporting and automation across Canadian CIT operations. The role serves as the primary Operations owner for OCEAN, Dolphin and related operational platforms, connecting outside and vault operations with IT, Global Application teams and business stakeholders. The position ensures systems work effectively in practice, processes are consistently executed, data and reporting are reliable, users are supported and changes are successfully adopted across the national network.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own day-to-day operational support for OCEAN, Dolphin and related CIT platforms, integrations and reporting tools.

* Act as the primary Operations contact and escalation point for system issues, user inquiries, incidents and service disruptions.

* Coordinate ticket intake, triage, prioritization and resolution with IT, Global Application teams, vendors and operational stakeholders.

* Analyze recurring incidents and lead sustainable corrective actions that reduce disruption and improve the user experience.

* Design, document and maintain standardized operational processes, controls, SOPs, work instructions, process maps and knowledge materials.

* Align system functionality, master data and business rules with outside and vault operating requirements across multiple locations.

Title: IT & Security Manager
Description:
**The Role**
------------

In a little over a year and a half, Blank Metal has more than doubled in size. The IT, security, and compliance work that comes with that growth has been handled by whoever had time, including the COO. That worked for 12 people. It doesn’t at 50, and it won’t at 100.

Our clients now hand us security addendums before kickoff, expect SOC 2 reports and annual risk questionnaires, write US-only data processing into their contracts, and audit us as a delegated entity under Medicare rules. Meanwhile our own engineers are running two laptops each, model-provider API keys are managed by hand, and nobody can tell you where every machine is. You will own all of it: the help queue, the device fleet, the security program, the compliance evidence, and the operational side of the AI stack that runs our business.

This is a build role and a player-coach role. You’ll write the policy and ship the laptop in the same afternoon. The mandate is right-sized: we scope controls to the obligations we actually have and add more when a contract or an audit finding says to, not because a framework says we might need it someday. Success in the first year looks like a clear device baseline, a passed SOC 2 Type I with Type II underway, security questionnaires answered in days instead of weeks, and a picture of what we spend on models and why.

**What You Get To Do**
----------------------

### ***Run the shop***

* Own the internal help queue end to end. Blank Metal engineers are fast and impatient; you’ll keep them that way by making account setup, access, and troubleshooting a same-day thing.
* Build the device lifecycle we don’t have yet: procurement and vendor relationships, imaging, mobile device management, inventory, loaners, repairs, and retirement. You’ll know where every laptop is and whose it is.
* Make onboarding and offboarding a checklist that runs in hours for employees and contractors alike, including the client-issued machines and accounts that come with each engagement.
* Administer the core stack (Google Workspace, 1Password, Slack, Zoom, GitHub) with sane access policies, and be the person who says no to the fourth note-taking app.
* Own the hardware and software budget and get us to a standard kit, with spares on the shelf, without overspending.

### ***Make security something we can prove***

* Take Blank Metal through SOC 2: pick the compliance automation platform, scope the controls to our real obligations, run the audit, and keep the evidence current.
* Be the standing answer to client security questionnaires, security addendums, and data protection exhibits, working alongside our outside counsel so what we commit to is what we can actually do.
* Write and own the policies that are missing today (access control, data retention and destruction, acceptable use, device, incident response) and make them short enough that people follow them.
* Serve as the technical counterpart to our healthcare compliance program, translating Medicare- and HIPAA-regulated requirements into controls engineers can live with.
* Review the tools we adopt (AI note-takers, browser extensions, SaaS) against what our client contracts allow, before someone connects them.

### ***Keep the AI stack accountable***

* Own the accounts, API keys, and access to our model providers and cloud environments, with rotation, scoping, and attribution by client and project.
* Stand up usage and cost observability for model spend so leadership can see token cost by engagement, tie it to margin, and catch surprises before the invoice does.
* Enforce data residency and handling rules for AI workloads, including US-only processing, no-training clauses, and environment isolation for client data.
* Provision secure, repeatable working environments for engineers and contractors, so a new team member is productive on day one without a security exception.
* Contribute to large client engagements that need infrastructure stood up: cloud accounts, model hosting, access patterns, audit logging. You set the pattern; delivery teams carry it.

**What Will Help You Succeed**
------------------------------

* 5+ years running IT and security at a company under 200 people, ideally one that handles regulated data. You’ve been the one who answered the questionnaire and sat with the auditor.
* You’ve taken a company through SOC 2 from nothing (HITRUST or a HIPAA program is a plus) and know what auditors actually look at versus what the platform dashboard says.
* Hands-on with a Mac fleet: Google Workspace admin, MDM (Jamf, Kandji, or similar), SSO and identity, password management. You don’t need a ticket to fix a ticket.
* Comfortable in at least one major cloud and with the LLM provider ecosystem. You’ve managed API keys and quotas, set up a gateway or proxy, and can read a token bill and explain it to a CFO.
* You can read a security addendum and tell a lawyer, in plain English, which clauses we can sign and which we can’t.
* A right-sizer by instinct. You scope controls to real obligations, say when something is over-built, and sequence investment on evidence rather than fear.
* You write clearly. Policies, questionnaire answers, and Slack replies that people actually read and act on.
* Patient with the help queue and unbothered by it. Reimaging a laptop is not beneath you, and neither is presenting to leadership.

**Why You’ll Love It Here**
---------------------------

* Build AI that ships: every project ends in a live deployment, not a slide deck
* Craft meets velocity: we obsess over quality while delivering at startup speed
* Outcome-driven model: our work aligns with client success, not billable hours
* AI-native culture: you’ll work with peers who deeply understand modern AI’s potential and limits
* Real collaboration: open conversations, shared ownership, and space to bring your voice

Title: SOC Project Manager – SOC Lead (Secret Clearance)
Description:
**Who we are:**

ShorePoint is a fast-growing, industry-recognized and award-winning cybersecurity services firm focused on high-profile, high-threat public and private sector customers who demand experience and proven security models to protect their data. We embrace a “work hard, play hard” mentality and celebrate individual and company successes. We are passionate about our mission and going above and beyond to deliver for our customers, while fostering an environment that supports creativity, accountability, mission success, critical thinking and a desire to give back to our community.

**The Perks:**

As recognized members of the Cyber Elite, we work together in partnership to defend our nation’s critical infrastructure while building meaningful and exciting career development opportunities in a culture tailored to the individual’s technical and professional growth. We are committed to the belief that our team members do their best work when they are happy and well cared for. In support of this philosophy, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, major carriers for healthcare providers. Highlighted benefits include 144 hours of PTO, 11 holidays, 85% of insurance premiums covered, a 401(k), continuing education, certification maintenance and reimbursement and more.

**Who we’re looking for:**

We are seeking a **SOC Project Manager – SOC Lead (Secret Clearance)** to lead and manage all Security Operations Center functions. The SOC Lead will ensure unified service delivery across sub-task areas, provide operational direction and influence executive leadership to align security operations with enterprise objectives. The **SOC Project Manager – SOC Lead** role requires deep expertise in SOC management, incident response and hybrid on-premises/cloud environments. This is a unique opportunity to shape the growth, development and culture of an exciting and fast-growing company in the cybersecurity market.

**What you’ll be doing:**

  

* Lead a 24x7x365 SOC for unclassified environments. Ensure shift managers and escalation contacts cover every shift and on-call support is available for incident response.
* Coordinate task execution across sub-task leads to achieve enterprise-level objectives.
* Oversee the integration and coordination of on-premises and cloud-based SOC capabilities.
* Communicate effectively with executive leadership and stakeholders on SOC performance and posture.
* Ensure SOC operations adhere to the full NIST Cybersecurity Framework: Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond and Recover.
* Manage dedicated business-hours coverage commitments for specific customer offices, including staggered shift scheduling.
* Serve as, or direct, the Incident Commander for significant and widespread incidents. Responsibilities include:
  + Lead incident calls.
  + Coordinate response across all teams and task orders.
  + Manage government notifications and stakeholder communications.
  + Track after-action items through remediation.
* Direct the task order incident coordinators within each sub-task area. Ensure playbook adherence and full incident lifecycle documentation in the ticketing system.
* Oversee required reporting to federal oversight bodies, the Inspector General and law enforcement. Oversee reporting of classified spills onto unclassified systems.
* Coordinate with interagency and intelligence community partners such as CISA, the FBI and DHS.
* Execute the operational side of SOC consolidation:
  + Onboarding new customer organizations’ log sources and alerting.
  + Standardizing detection logic, escalation protocols and playbooks.
  + Transitioning onboarded organizations into steady-state operations and maintenance.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, incident response playbooks, an alert severity and triage framework, and standardized reporting templates.
* Own SOC performance metrics: mean time to detect, mean time to respond, alert volumes, false positive rates, ticket closure rates and SLA compliance. Explain any deviations and propose corrective actions.
* Build a centralized incident knowledge base and lessons-learned repository that is shared across customer organizations.
* Lead adoption of AI-enabled analytics and next-generation security automation.

  

**What you need to know:**

  

* Strong background in cybersecurity incident response across large, complex enterprise environments.
* Proven ability to align SOC functions with the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
* Experience coordinating subordinate managers and technical leads to deliver cohesive operations.
* Skilled at influencing executive leadership and driving organizational adoption of SOC best practices
* Hands-on SOC leadership experience with Splunk/Splunk ES and EDR platforms such as Trellix/FireEye HX and Microsoft Defender.
* Experience with ServiceNow-based incident management, network intrusion detection (Snort/Zeek), threat intelligence platforms (MISP, STIX/TAXII) and vulnerability tools (Tenable, Qualys).
* Experience managing 24x7 shift-based workforces, including scheduling, coverage, retention and escalation structures.
* Familiarity with federal incident reporting requirements and OMB M-21-31 event logging maturity.

  

**Must have’s:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree or 3+ additional years of relevant experience in lieu of degree.
* 10+ years managing SOC operations and incident response for enterprise environments (50,000+ endpoints), including 5+ years leading hybrid on-premises/cloud SOCs with full NIST Cybersecurity Framework coverage.
* Proven ability to analyze complex requirements and translate them into clear, actionable tasks and processes through critical thinking.
* Applicants must hold and maintain an active Secret clearance.

  

**Beneficial to have the following:**

  

* Hold one or more of the following active certifications: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA), GIAC Security Operations Manager (GSOM) or Certified Information Security Manager (CISM).
* Experience integrating multiple organizations into a consolidated SOC.

  

**Where it’s done:**

  

* Onsite (Washington, DC).

Title: Digitalisation & Technology Manager
Description:
Six Construct, a subsidiary of the BESIX Group, is the largest Belgian construction company operating in the Middle East. The company combines the efforts of a highly skilled workforce, along with strategic planning and innovative use of technology to overcome the most complex business challenges. Six Construct is a multi-services company that operates in the construction of commercial and residential buildings, sport and leisure facilities, infrastructure and marine-related projects. The company currently employs a workforce of approximately 4,000 in the Middle East, and a total of 10,000 worldwide.

**Job Description**

**Why This Role Matters**

We are seeking a forward-thinking
**Digital & Technology Manager**
to drive the digital transformation agenda across our business. This role will be responsible for identifying, evaluating, and implementing innovative technologies that improve operational efficiency, project delivery, collaboration, and data-driven decision-making.

The successful candidate will play a key role in shaping our digital strategy, fostering a culture of innovation, and ensuring the effective adoption of emerging technologies, including AI, automation, advanced analytics, digital platforms, and construction technologies. The role will work closely with business leaders, operations teams, project teams, and external technology partners to create measurable business value.

**What You'll Drive**

* Shape the digital journey of the new construction company, defining how technology and data can support the company from start-up through its first project and subsequent growth.
