Title: Director, Risk and Performance Technology
Description:
At IMCO, our talent is among the best! IMCO offers a uniquely stimulating and rewarding environment where you can help build and drive organizational transformation, all while seeking to challenge yourself, learn, and grow your career.
  
  
Our culture is built on collaboration and passion, with a shared commitment to delivering lasting value to the clients we serve. Located in downtown Toronto, our vision is to be the partner of choice for Ontario’s public sector funds and to build a high-performing, value-driven asset management firm.
  
  
This job posting is for an existing vacancy. If you are ready to deliver best-in-class service and join a collaborative, motivated and fun team of professionals, IMCO offers the opportunity to do impactful work and broaden your expertise.
  
  
If you’re looking to use your expertise to drive strategic outcomes, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
‎
  
  
As IMCO continues to evolve its Target Operating Model, the importance of timely, trusted, and actionable risk and performance insights continues to grow. Technology plays a critical role in enabling investment decision-making, performance measurement, portfolio analytics, regulatory reporting, and enterprise risk oversight.
  
  
If you are looking to lead a strategic technology portfolio and help shape the future of Risk and Performance capabilities at IMCO, we would love to hear from you.
  
  
**We are looking for a highly motivated Director, Risk & Performance Technology.**
Reporting to the Vice President, Investment Technology, the Director, Risk & Performance Technology is accountable for the strategy, delivery, operation, and evolution of IMCO's Risk and Performance technology capabilities.
  
  
This role provides technology leadership for the applications, analytical platforms, reporting capabilities, and integrations that support Risk and Performance. The Director will establish the roadmap for the Risk and Performance technology portfolio, lead key technology initiatives, and ensure technology capabilities remain scalable, reliable, and aligned with IMCO's future operating model.
  
  
The role partners closely with Risk, Performance, Investment Operations, Data & AI Enablement, Enterprise Technology, and Front Office stakeholders to improve analytical capabilities, enhance reporting and measurement processes, and deliver trusted insights across the organization.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
Technology Strategy & Business Partnership
  
  

* Define and execute the multi-year technology roadmap for Risk and Performance capabilities, ensuring alignment with business priorities and IMCO's Target Operating Model.
* Serve as a trusted technology advisor to leaders across Risk and Performance.
* Partner with business stakeholders to identify future capability needs, technology opportunities, and process improvement initiatives.
* Contribute to Investment Technology planning activities and support the development of long-term technology strategies across the investment ecosystem.
* Support business case development, vendor evaluations, and technology investment decisions related to Risk and Performance platforms.

Risk & Performance Solution Delivery
  
  

* Lead the delivery and enhancement of technology solutions supporting portfolio risk measurement, factor analytics, exposure analysis, performance measurement, attribution, benchmark management, and investment reporting.
* Oversee the design, implementation, integration, and support of business-critical applications and analytical platforms.
* Ensure solutions are designed to support scalability, automation, operational efficiency, and future business growth.
* Partner with Architecture, Data Platform & AI Engineering, Enterprise Technology, and Cyber Security teams to ensure alignment with enterprise standards and target architectures.
* Promote effective delivery practices and ensure technology solutions are implemented in a disciplined and sustainable manner.

**Application Portfolio Ownership**

* Provide overall ownership and oversight of Risk and Performance technology platforms and application portfolios.
* Establish application roadmaps, lifecycle management plans, and support strategies that align with business objectives.
* Lead application upgrades, enhancements, integrations, modernization initiatives, and platform rationalization activities.
* Evaluate emerging vendor solutions and analytical capabilities to support evolving business requirements.
* Manage strategic relationships with software vendors, implementation partners, and service providers.

Data, Analytics & Reporting Enablement
  
  

* Partner with the Data Platform & AI Engineering team and business stakeholders to ensure Risk and Performance solutions leverage trusted, governed, and reconciled investment data.
* Support the development and consumption of analytical data products, calculation engines, and reporting-ready datasets.
* Drive improvements in measurement processes, reporting workflows, calculation transparency, and analytical consistency.
* Promote the adoption of common data standards and integrated analytical capabilities across investment teams.
* Enable modern analytics, reporting, and decision-support capabilities that improve investment insight and business outcomes.

Governance & Operational Excellence
  
  

* Ensure Risk and Performance technology solutions operate in accordance with IMCO policies, architecture standards, security requirements, and governance frameworks.
* Establish operational processes that support stable, secure, and sustainable application services.
* Oversee incident, problem, change, release, and service management activities across the portfolio.
* Support audits, risk assessments, compliance reviews, and control testing activities.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, training materials, support procedures, and operational controls are maintained.

People Leadership
  
  

* Build and lead a high-performing team of business analysts, application specialists, technical leads, and technology professionals.
* Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Coach, mentor, and develop team members to support career growth and organizational capability development.
* Establish clear objectives, performance expectations, and development plans aligned with business and technology goals.

**What you need to succeed:**

* 12+ years of progressive experience delivering and supporting investment technology solutions within asset management, investment management, or financial services environments.
* Demonstrated success leading technology teams supporting Risk, Performance, Analytics, or related investment functions.
* Strong understanding of portfolio risk management, performance measurement and attribution, benchmark management, investment reporting, and portfolio analytics.
* Experience developing technology roadmaps and delivering complex application and platform initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of investment data, analytical platforms, reporting solutions, and application integration patterns.
* Experience managing software vendors, implementation partners, and managed service providers.
* Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery methodologies.
* Strong understanding of application lifecycle management, service management, governance, and operational support practices.
* Excellent communication, relationship management, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Experience with industry-leading Risk and Performance platforms such as MSCI RiskManager, BarraOne, Axioma, FactSet, Bloomberg PORT, Eagle Performance, or similar solutions is highly desirable.
* Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, Mathematics, or a related field. Advanced education and professional certifications are considered an asset.

‎
  
  
We thank all applicants for their interest. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.
  
  
Our hybrid work model prioritizes an office-first approach, encouraging employees to make the most of our collaborative workspace at 16 York Street, Suite 2400, Toronto, ON M5J 0E6. This welcoming environment fosters teamwork, connection, and professional growth. While flexibility remains a key component of our model, we believe that regular in-office engagement enhances productivity and strengthens our culture. Our approach supports a fulfilling lifestyle that balances professional ambition with personal wellbeing.
  
  
*IMCO is committed to providing accommodation for people with disabilities throughout the recruitment process. If you require support, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs. Artificial intelligence (AI) tools may be used to support parts of our recruitment process, such as screening and assessments. However, all hiring decisions are made by our recruitment team. Candidates being considered for this position will be required to undergo background screening.*

Title: Director, IT Business Unit
Industry: IT Services and IT Consulting and Engineering Services
Description:
**Director, IT Business Unit – Toronto**

**The mandate**

As Director of the IT Business Unit in Toronto, you will have end-to-end responsibility for building and scaling ALTEN Canada’s IT services business in Ontario.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining
**business strategy, client development, P&L ownership, consultant management and delivery development**
. You will define the market approach, grow strategic accounts, build new client relationships and help expand ALTEN Canada’s IT delivery capabilities in Toronto.

The role is designed for a commercially driven leader who can think strategically, build from the ground up and personally drive execution.

**What you will lead**

* Define and execute the
  **Ontario IT services strategy**
  and 2027–2030 commercial roadmap.
* Build and own the business plan for the Toronto IT Business Unit, including market priorities, growth targets, revenue, gross margin and profitability.
* Identify priority industries, strategic accounts, technology disciplines and service offerings with the strongest potential for growth.
* Develop a balanced services portfolio spanning
  **staff augmentation, project-based and turnkey solutions, and local, onshore and offshore delivery models**
  .
* Grow existing Canadian and global accounts through structured account planning, cross-selling and senior stakeholder engagement.
* Generate new business through targeted market development, executive-level prospecting, consultative selling, proposal leadership and contract negotiation.
* Own the full
  **P&L and commercial performance**
  of the portfolio, including revenue, gross margin, pricing, forecasting and budget discipline.
* Oversee consultants assigned to client engagements, maintaining strong performance, engagement, retention and client satisfaction.
* Partner closely with recruitment, technical, delivery, HR and finance teams to align client demand, talent capacity, pricing and delivery feasibility.
* Lead the expansion of ALTEN Canada’s IT delivery capabilities from Montreal into Toronto, identifying opportunities to move from individual consulting mandates toward higher-value project and solution-based engagements.
* Establish and monitor clear KPIs across pipeline, sales conversion, account growth, consultant utilization, delivery performance and profitability.
* Over time,
  **build, structure and lead the Toronto IT business team**
  in line with the growth of the portfolio.

**What you bring**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in
  **IT consulting, technology services or professional services**
  , with significant responsibility for business development and account growth.
* Proven experience building or scaling a
  **business unit, market, practice or strategic portfolio**
  , with measurable commercial results.
* Strong knowledge of the Ontario IT services market, enterprise buying processes and competitive landscape.
* A demonstrated ability to develop senior client relationships and open new enterprise accounts.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, including
  **pricing, forecasting, gross-margin management, budgeting and P&L accountability**
  .
* Experience leading complex sales cycles involving technical/delivery teams, recruitment, procurement, legal and senior client stakeholders.
* The ability to translate business challenges into relevant IT services, delivery models and commercial solutions.
* Experience managing consultants and/or commercial teams in a professional-services environment.
* Executive-level communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.
* A structured but entrepreneurial leadership style:
  **you can define the strategy, build internal alignment and personally drive execution.**

**Assets / Nice to have**

* Technical education or previous hands-on exposure to software development, cloud, infrastructure, data, cybersecurity, ERP, automation or related disciplines.
* Experience building or managing a
  **delivery centre, managed-services practice or project-based delivery capability**
  .
* Experience working with global, nearshore and offshore delivery models.
* An established network within the
  **Greater Toronto Area and Ontario enterprise IT market**
  .
* Experience building and developing business managers, account executives or sales teams.

Title: Data Strategy & Data Enabled Solutions - Senior Manager or Associate Director - Toronto
Description:
Location: Toronto

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Nov 9, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1759846

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

  

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

  

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  

**The opportunity**

  

EY’s Canada Tax & Law Technology Group (CTTG) is seeking an experienced Associate Director / Senior Manager, Data Strategy & Data-Enabled Solutions to help define and scale our data strategy, capabilities, offerings, and solutions.

  

This is a strategic and hands-on role that will play a pivotal part in shaping how data is leveraged as a strategic asset across Tax & Law. The role will focus on identifying new opportunities, enabling data-driven insights and decision-making, developing new solutions and services, strengthening existing offerings, and enabling smarter and more scalable service delivery.

We are looking for a senior data professional who can move comfortably between strategy and execution. The successful candidate will be expected to help set direction while also working directly with data to explore opportunities, develop analyses, test hypotheses, prototype solutions, and evaluate new approaches and technologies. They will leverage CTTG development and delivery resources to help engineer, productionize, and scale solutions where needed.

  

This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Partner with Tax & Law leadership to define and execute a data strategy that advances service delivery, managed services, growth, and new market offerings, including opportunities to connect data and insights across competencies and services.
* Identify, prioritize, and shape data-enabled opportunities, use cases, and solutions aligned with business priorities, client needs, and the long-term technology and platform strategy.
* Lead discovery with business teams to understand business problems, processes, available data, information gaps, and opportunities, and articulate the art of the possible through data.
* Work hands-on with data to explore opportunities, perform analysis, test hypotheses, identify patterns and insights, develop prototypes, and demonstrate potential solutions.
* Experiment with new data sources, data models, analytical approaches, tools, and technologies to quickly assess feasibility, validate ideas, and determine potential business value.
* Design and prototype end-to-end data-enabled solutions, including data extraction, preparation, transformation, integration, modeling, analytics, visualization, and consumption.
* Define data architectures and solution approaches that enable information to be securely, effectively, and consistently used and reused across solutions, services, and teams.
* Apply and leverage technologies such as Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft Dataverse, Azure data services, Alteryx, APIs, ETL/ELT tools, and related data and analytics technologies.
* Work across structured and unstructured data sources and develop approaches for ingesting, connecting, transforming, and deriving value from disparate sources of information.
* Partner with developers, architects, and agile delivery teams to evolve successful prototypes and experiments into secure, scalable, supportable, and reusable solutions.
* Provide technical direction and hands-on support throughout solution development, helping teams address complex data, architecture, analytics, and integration challenges.
* Translate successful approaches into repeatable data assets, solutions, services, and market offerings that can be leveraged more broadly across Tax & Law.
* Collaborate with technology, risk, security, privacy, and enablement teams to ensure solutions align with EY standards, data governance, and compliance requirements.
* Help strengthen data capability and maturity across service line by establishing reusable approaches, sharing leading practices, and helping teams understand how data can be more effectively leveraged.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

  

The successful candidate will bring a strong background in data strategy, analytics, data architecture, and hands-on solution development, and will operate as a connector between business leadership, data and technology teams, and solution delivery. They’ll combine the mindset of a strategist, problem solver, and builder: someone who can identify where data can create value, determine how to solve the problem, prove what is possible, and work with a broader team to turn successful ideas into scalable solutions, services, and market offerings.

  

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Demonstrated experience defining or contributing to data strategies, data architectures, analytics roadmaps, data products, or data-enabled service offerings.
* Experience taking ambiguous business opportunities or problems from discovery and exploration through prototyping, solution design, and implementation.
* Experience designing and delivering solutions involving data ingestion, extraction, transformation, integration, modeling, analysis, and visualization.
* Hands-on experience with data preparation, transformation, and integration technologies such as Alteryx or comparable ETL/ELT tools.
* Hands-on experience with data visualization, analytics, or business intelligence platforms such as Power BI.
* Experience working with diverse data platforms, data models, and both structured and unstructured data sources.
* Experience working with APIs, integration patterns, and modern cloud-based data architectures.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, data product delivery, and agile methodologies.
* Experience gathering and translating business requirements and guiding solutions from concept and prototype through implementation and scale.
* Experience collaborating with developers, architects, and other technical specialists to productionize and scale solutions.
* Exposure to the Microsoft ecosystem, including Power Platform, Dataverse, and Azure data services, is highly desirable.

  

**What we look for**

* A Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field. An advanced degree is an asset.
* 8–12+ years of experience in data strategy, analytics, data engineering, applied data science, technology consulting, or related roles, with meaningful responsibility for delivering data-enabled solutions.

  

**What we offer**

  

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package allows you to decide which benefits are right for you and which ones help you create a solid foundation for your future. Our Total Rewards package includes a discretionary bonus program, a comprehensive medical, prescription drug and dental coverage plan, a defined contribution pension plan, a great vacation policy plus firm paid days that allow you to enjoy longer long weekends throughout the year, statutory holidays and paid personal days (based on province of residence), and a range of exciting programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer:

* *Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues in the industry*
* *Learning opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career*
* *The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you*

  

EY reports salary ranges in accordance with applicable provincial pay transparency legislation. Individual salaries within the anticipated salary ranges noted below are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to internal equity, education, relevant experience, knowledge, and applicable skill sets.

* Director: $160,000 to $240,000
* Senior Manager: $128,000 to $192,000

  

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

  

To help create the best experience during the recruitment process, please describe any accommodations you may need.

  

**Inclusiveness at EY**

  

Inclusiveness is at the heart of who we are and how we work. We’re committed to fostering an environment where differences are valued, policies and practices are equitable, and our people feel a sense of belonging. We embrace diversity and are committed to combating systemic racism, advancing gender equity and women in leadership, advocating for the 2SLGBTQIA+ community, promoting our neuroinclusion and accessibility initiatives, and are dedicated to amplifying the voices of Indigenous peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis) nationally as we strive towards reconciliation. Our diverse experiences, abilities, backgrounds, and perspectives make our people unique and help guide us. Because when people feel free to be their authentic selves at work, they bring their best and are empowered to build a better working world.

  

Learn about our commitment to Inclusiveness at https://www.ey.com/en\_ca/about-us/corporate-responsibility/equity

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

  

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

  

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Title: Head of BFSI
Description:
**Who we are**  
  
ML arteka is one of the fastest-growing IT Services and Consulting companies in Canada and serves some of the most iconic brands, including Google, Loblaws, Staples, Telus, Bell, Rogers, CIBC, BMO, CMLS, Fossil, Fitbit and more.  
  
Over the last decade, we have achieved 100% client retention and earned more than 20 notable industry recognition. This reflects our reliability in delivering what we promise and the quality we bring to every engagement.  
  
Join our growth-driven culture and help us lead, innovate, and simplify. We are looking for a team members who embody our values:

* Empathetic - we listen, we understand, and are considerate of everyone
* Persevering - we don't give up on challenges or people and go all the way
* Inclusive - we value everyone and their perspectives
* Reliable - we deliver what we promise, and more
* Innovative - we make things better than they were yesterday

  

**The role**  
  
We are seeking a Head of BFSI to **originate and grow** our Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance business across Canada and the United States. This is a **consultative business development leadership** role designed for a senior professional who combines deep BFSI domain expertise with strong technology acumen and the ability to build trusted executive relationships.  
  
You will create a pipeline by engaging BFSI executives on their modernization agenda, shaping opportunities into structured offers (**POV/assessment MVP scale**), and converting those into multi-year programs. You will partner closely with Sales for commercial execution and with internal practice leaders (Data & AI, Cloud, App Innovation) for solution depth and delivery confidence.  
  
This is not transactional selling. Revenue is generated through credibility, insight, and advisory-led origination—not volume outreach or RFP chasing.

  
**Why** **ML arteka****?**  
  
**Most senior BFSI leaders don’t lack ideas—they lack room to act.**

* Room to move faster than RFP cycles and internal red tape. Room to turn executive conversations into funded modernization programs. Room to own outcomes, not activity.

**At** **ML arteka****, this role is built for people who think:**

* “I can build more pipeline if I’m not boxed into bureaucracy.”
* “BFSI buyers need a modernization partner, not another vendor.”
* “I want accountability for conversion—assessment MVP scale—not just meetings.”
* “I want to build a durable BFSI portfolio, not manage accounts.”

**Originate, Don’t Just Network**

* This isn’t about collecting contacts. It’s about creating demand—shaping modernization triggers into structured offers and multi-year programs.

**Operate Like an Owner**

* You’ll have autonomy to build the BFSI growth motion: target accounts, executive coverage, positioning, and deal shaping—partnering with practices and Sales to make programs defensible and repeatable.

**Move Fast, Keep Rigor**

* BFSI modernization demands speed and discipline (risk, compliance, security, resilience). If slow decision cycles frustrate you, you’ll find this environment refreshing and demanding—in the right way.

**A Place for Builders**

* Not for narrow lanes or comfort-first roles. If you want to build a BFSI growth engine and leave a mark, ML arteka is the platform.

**Why This Role Exists**  
  
BFSI enterprises are under unprecedented pressure to modernize:

* Core platforms and legacy applications
* Data estates and analytics foundations
* Risk, compliance, and regulatory capabilities
* Cloud and infrastructure operating models
* AI adoption across fraud, risk, operations, and customer experience

Despite heavy investment, many initiatives stall due to lack of clarity, fragmented execution, and misalignment between business and technology.  
Our firm exists to help BFSI organizations modernize with clarity, control, and measurable outcomes. The Head of BFSI will translate this mission into a sustainable, repeatable **growth engine**.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
**1) Consultative Origination & Pipeline Ownership**

* Own BFSI growth by building pipeline through **executive discovery** and problem-led conversations.
* Develop and maintain a **target account plan** (named accounts, buying centers, modernization triggers, stakeholder maps).
* Identify high-impact BFSI challenges and translate them into structured engagements:
  + POVs and executive workshops
  + Assessments and roadmaps
  + MVPs / pilots
  + Multi-year modernization programs
* Sponsor the progression of clients from **assessment MVP scale**, ensuring opportunities are capability-led and repeatable—not opportunistic.
* Act as executive sponsor on strategic deals and long-term programs; partner with Sales on pursuit orchestration and commercial closure.
* Maintain pipeline hygiene: stage quality, next steps, close plans, and predictable coverage.

**2) Executive Coverage & Relationship Development**

* Serve as the outward-facing BFSI leader and build trusted relationships with:
  + CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CISOs
  + Heads of Risk, Compliance, Operations, Digital, and Data
* Engage clients as a thought partner and modernization advisor; convert executive alignment into funded programs.
* Represent the firm at BFSI events, conferences, and executive forums.
* Lead and contribute to BFSI thought leadership (POVs, whitepapers, panels, roundtables).

**3) Territory/Account Strategy & Growth Plays**

* Define and own the BFSI market strategy for your region/territory.
* Identify priority lines of business, such as:
  + Retail & Commercial Banking
  + Payments & Cards
  + Capital Markets
  + Wealth & Asset Management
  + Insurance
  + Risk, Compliance, and Financial Crime
* Develop BFSI-specific value propositions and use cases aligned to enterprise modernization priorities.
* Shape a BFSI-focused, capability-led GTM model in partnership with practice leaders and Sales.

**4) Deal Shaping (Assessment MVP Scale)**

* Lead discovery with BFSI clients; translate business and regulatory challenges into technology-enabled modernization programs.
* Sponsor and guide solution shaping across:
  + Modernization assessments and roadmaps
  + Data and AI readiness initiatives
  + Platform, cloud, and infrastructure transformation programs
* Partner closely with internal practices (Data & AI, Cloud, App Innovation) to ensure solutions are outcome-driven, realistic, and defensible.
* Ensure pricing and estimation are disciplined; protect margin integrity by validating assumptions, scope, and delivery approach.

**5) Offering Influence & Differentiation**

* Influence the development of BFSI offerings and accelerators that improve repeatability, win-rate, and conversion to multi-year programs.
* Ensure solutions reflect BFSI expectations:
  + Regulatory rigor

Title: GIS Technician II - Utility Pole Program Lead
Description:
**Job Title:** GIS Technician II - Utility Pole Program Lead  
**Department:** Operations – Electric Utilities  
**Reports To:** Senior Survey Technician/Project Manager  
  
The GIS Technician II - Utility Pole Program Lead is responsible for managing, processing, and analyzing utility infrastructure data collected in the field for electric utility programs. This role supports pole inventory, joint-use audits, and distribution system mapping initiatives by transforming field-collected data into accurate datasets used for engineering design, asset management, and utility planning.  
  
Working closely with field crews and project managers, the GIS Technician II reviews incoming data for accuracy, coordinates data collection requirements, and processes information within platforms such as Katapult Pro, ESRI Field Maps, GIS systems, and related software tools.  
  
This position plays a critical role in ensuring utility infrastructure data is accurate, complete, and delivered in accordance with client standards.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
**Field Data Coordination**

* Coordinate with field crews responsible for collecting pole inventory and utility infrastructure data.
* Develop and distribute field data collection packages and project instructions.
* Provide ongoing support to field personnel regarding data collection requirements and standards.
* Track project progress and field data submission status.

  
**Data Processing & Analysis**

* Process field data within Katapult Pro workflows including pole modeling, attachment identification, and field verification review.
* Validate field photos and measurements to ensure pole loading analysis requirements are met.

  
**Pole Inventory & Joint-Use Analysis**

* Review pole inventory data to confirm attachment ownership and pole characteristics.
* Analyze joint-use attachment data including telecommunications and cable infrastructure.
* Ensure collected data meets utility and engineering requirements for pole loading analysis and design.

**Software & Data Management**

* Manage and process data within industry platforms including:
  + Katapult Pro
  + ESRI Field Maps
  + GIS systems
  + CAD or mapping software as required
* Maintain organized project data repositories and ensure proper version control.

**Quality Assurance**

* Perform quality checks on incoming field data including photo documentation, GPS data, and asset attributes.
* Identify discrepancies or missing data and coordinate corrections with field crews.
* Ensure deliverables meet internal QC standards and client specifications.

  
**Project Coordination**

* Work closely with Project Managers to ensure project schedules and deliverables are met.
* Provide technical support to field crews collecting pole inventory data.
* Review incoming field data daily to identify missing attributes, incorrect measurements, or documentation gaps.
* Coordinate data corrections and re-collection when necessary.

  
**Qualifications**

* 2+ years experience processing utility data, GIS datasets, or pole inventory/joint-use programs.
* Experience supporting electric utility infrastructure projects preferred.
* Experience working with pole inventory or joint-use datasets highly preferred.
* An educational background in Land Surveying, Geomatics, or a related field is preferred.
* In-depth knowledge of surveying principles, techniques, and procedures.
* Problem solving and organizational skills are necessary.
* Strong communication and leadership abilities.

  
The GIS Technician II - Utility Pole Program Lead works in the office, providing technical support and leadership in surveying operations. This role involves data processing and collaboration with survey teams.  
  
This job description is intended to provide an overview of the responsibilities and qualifications for the GIS Technician II - Utility Pole Program Lead position. It is not an exhaustive list, and responsibilities may evolve to meet the changing needs of the organization.

Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Customers want what they need in minutes, not days. Join Amazon's Last Mile team in the Middle East, Africa and Turkey to shape how our fastest delivery services, including Amazon Now and Amazon Rush, grow and run for customers, delivery associates, Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) and Amazon.  
  
As Senior Program Manager, you will own and lead the strategic programmes that set how our Speed last mile network runs across the region. At the core is flexible capacity: designing models that let DSP capacity move up and down with demand, setting how they fit into annual and weekly planning, and getting Operations, Finance, People teams and DSP partners behind them. Your portfolio may also cover partner commercials, compliance and training, and it will change as priorities change.  
  
Many problems won't arrive well defined. You will frame them, find the ones worth solving, align senior stakeholders on a path forward and build mechanisms that make the answers scale across countries. You will also help shape the team's wider strategy and roadmap.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Set the strategy: own the multi-year capacity and growth plan for Quick Commerce and Speed, and the region's input to annual planning.
* Plan capacity: within the regional plan, build short, mid and long range plans that match DSP and delivery associate supply to demand by hour, day and season.
* Build flexible capacity: design, launch and scale flexible models alongside the fixed DSP network, with the operating, commercial and compliance framework to run them.
* Grow the channel: launch new cities, stores and countries with capacity ready before go-live.
* Improve efficiency: raise utilisation and lower cost per delivery without moving cost onto DSPs or associates.
* Build partner economics: shape DSP commercial models with Finance that work at every volume level, and lead the trade-off decisions.
* Look after delivery associates: design fair, safe, compliant schedules and lead the regional response to labour rule changes.
* Align and lead change: bring Operations, Finance, People, Legal, Tech and DSPs behind one plan, and run readiness and approvals.
* Build mechanisms: set planning tool requirements with Tech, and the metrics, guardrails and reviews that run the channel, using automation and AI.
* Lead and write: influence senior leaders, mentor PMs and analysts, and write documents that drive decisions.

  
A day in the life  
You start with yesterday's Quick Commerce and Speed performance: where capacity matched demand, where routes ran short or associates sat idle, and what it cost. Mid-morning, you join the weekly planning review to agree where flexible capacity steps in next week. You then meet a DSP owner to test a new flexible model against their margin and their associates' hours. After lunch, you work with Finance and Legal on the case for scaling it to a second country. You end the day writing for senior leaders: what the pilot showed, what you recommend and what you need from them.  
  
About the team  
This is a new role reporting to the Senior Manager, Strategy and Expansion, MEATr DSP. Quick Commerce and Speed, including Amazon Now and Amazon Rush, are delivered by DSPs, and flexible capacity is a lead theme in the region's 2027 plan. You will own Speed capacity and flexible capacity programmes across the region, planning inside the regional capacity plan and working with the Network Optimisation team, who own rate cards. You will mentor PMs and analysts and write planning papers reviewed at Director and VP level.

* 2+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

Title: Manufacturing Project Director (AI Chip Manufacturing) – UAE
Description:
Contract: 18 months

Location: United Arab Emirates

This is a rare “build it from scratch” role with a US AI chip manufacturer expanding into the UAE.

You’ll lead a greenfield manufacturing programme from early concept and site selection through build, commissioning, qualification and ramp-up to stable output. It’s hands-on, high visibility, and sits right at the intersection of executive leadership, government stakeholders, contractors, and the supply chain.

If you enjoy turning ambiguity into a plan, driving pace, and building teams and systems that actually work on day one, this one will suit you.

As Manufacturing Project Director, you will own the end-to-end delivery of a new UAE manufacturing facility supporting AI chip production and/or advanced electronics manufacturing operations. You’ll be accountable for delivering within the 18-month timeline, staying below budget, and meeting all regulatory, licensing, safety, quality and governance requirements.

You’ll act as the single point of accountability for programme delivery, while aligning US HQ expectations with UAE execution realities.

The outcome is a facility that is operationally ready, compliant, staffed, and capable of scaling.

What you’ll be doing

Build the facility and get it operational

* Lead the full lifecycle: feasibility and planning, design, construction, commissioning, qualification, production validation and handover.
* Drive site selection and coordinate with industrial zones, utilities, and infrastructure stakeholders.
* Select, appoint and manage EPC partners, engineering consultants, contractors and specialist vendors.
* Own readiness planning across layout, utilities, EHS, security, IT/OT, production support and day-one operating requirements.
* Build the operating model: org structure, roles, KPIs, routines, escalation paths, and performance management.
* Coordinate delivery across manufacturing, quality, supply chain, procurement, finance, IT and HR.

Industrialisation, localisation and supply chain

* Lead industrialisation planning and process transfer to enable sustainable local production.
* Build and qualify suppliers and service partners, balancing localisation goals with global quality and compliance standards.
* Put in place the supply chain backbone: critical components, tooling, spares, logistics, and service coverage.
* Work closely with regulators and authorities to secure approvals, permits and ongoing compliance.
* Identify practical opportunities to improve cost, throughput, yield, scalability and future expansion potential.

Governance, controls and stakeholder management

* Set up programme governance that leadership can trust: milestones, dependencies, RAID, reporting cadence, and decision forums.
* Manage budget, resourcing, delivery risks and change control, with clear, factual reporting to senior leadership.
* Build strong working relationships with contractors, suppliers, strategic partners and broader ecosystem stakeholders.
* Provide decision-ready recommendations on investment choices, workforce planning and delivery trade-offs.

People, safety and culture

* Build and lead a high-performing project team that can transition into steady-state operations.
* Embed a culture of pace, accountability and operational excellence.
* Make safety non-negotiable: safety-by-design, compliance, and disciplined execution on site.
* Coach leaders, develop capability, and promote safe working practices and wellbeing.

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Business or related field; MBA / Master’s preferred.
* 15+ years leadership experience across manufacturing, operations, industrialisation, transformation, infrastructure delivery or strategic programmes.
* Proven track record delivering complex, multi-stakeholder programmes with real-world constraints (time, budget, quality, compliance).
* Demonstrated experience setting up factories or large-scale operational facilities from inception through operational maturity.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen: budgets, investment decisions, governance, and executive-level reporting.
* Strong knowledge of operational excellence, Lean methodologies, organisational development and change management.
* Background in high-precision manufacturing environments is strongly preferred (semiconductor, advanced electronics, high-tech manufacturing, regulated industrial production).

Working style that fits this role

* Calm under pressure, structured thinker, and comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.
* Strong communicator who can align US HQ stakeholders, local authorities, and delivery teams without drama.
* Comfortable being on the ground, driving progress, removing blockers, and holding partners accountable.

Keywords

Greenfield manufacturing, factory setup, semiconductor manufacturing, AI chips, advanced electronics manufacturing, industrialisation, localisation, technology transfer, commissioning, qualification, production validation, ramp-up, operational readiness, EPC management, CAPEX delivery, programme governance, PMO, RAID, risk management, stakeholder management, UAE regulatory compliance, EHS, safety-by-design, Lean, operational excellence, supply chain build, supplier qualification, IT/OT readiness, leadership, change management.

* Support the establishment of Automation Centers of Excellence (CoE), governance frameworks and operating models to scale automation.
* Ensure process optimization precedes automation and drive benefits realization through productivity improvements, cost savings and cycle-time reduction.

Title: Director of Development & Automation
Description:
**Why Digacore?**
=================

We’re a fast-paced, people-first MSP with:

* Real career growth
* Autonomy to own projects and make decisions
* A collaborative culture (we back each other up, no egos)
* Paid certs, hybrid flexibility, and a leadership team that gets IT
* Recognition as one of New Jersey’s Top Workplaces for 2026

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a Director to take ownership of Digacore’s Development & Automation (DNA) team — a capable group of developers, data, product, and AI specialists working across three streams: AI services for clients, internal data and reporting, and a client-facing software product. The direction is set; now it needs a leader to turn it into structure, consistency, and results, so the CTO can step back from the day-to-day.

You’ll start by getting to know the team and what’s in flight, then put the foundation in place — SOPs, guidelines, a delivery cadence, and KPIs that give leadership a clear view of where things stand — and grow the team as the work demands. You’re comfortable rolling up your sleeves to unblock a build or prove out a solution, but your impact comes from leading through others, not writing the code yourself.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Lead the existing team:** learn each person’s strengths, set clear ownership, and manage each one the way they need — including senior specialists who are deeper than you in their own domains
* **Set the standards:** write and roll out SOPs and guidelines for how the team works — intake, prioritization, delivery, documentation, and handoffs — starting with our repeatable client AI Services processes
* **Own the KPIs:** define and track the metrics that prove impact (time to deploy, delivery against dates, time saved, adoption, ROI) and give the CTO a clear monthly view of what’s on track and what isn’t
* Run the team’s weekly delivery cadence so every initiative has an owner, a priority, a next step — and status is visible at any point without chasing people down
* Own the roadmap across all three streams — when urgent asks compete, decide what comes first, what waits, and what doesn’t happen, and reset expectations with stakeholders
* Take ownership of client AI engagements — assessment, setup, training, and custom builds — so they move from signed to live quickly and run without escalating to the CTO
* Oversee product releases with the Product Owner and developers — pressure-test estimates, surface risk early, and hold to commitments
* Back the internal data and reporting work — the data warehouse and leadership scorecard, including AI Services results — so leadership gets numbers it trusts
* Be the escalation point on client issues — including security, compliance, and data privacy questions — and prepare the team to handle them well
* Partner with leadership and department heads to identify manual work and friction, and turn it into automation and AI solutions
* Grow the team when needed — identify gaps, define new roles, and hire and onboard as the function scales
* Own tooling and vendor decisions, budget input, and capacity planning for the function

**What Success Looks Like in Year One**

* Every team member known with clear ownership, and every initiative inventoried with an owner, priority, and next step
* A weekly delivery cadence running, and a monthly KPI report the CTO can read in two minutes
* Core SOPs written and followed, starting with client AI deployment
* The CTO out of routine client engagements, with client builds moving from signed to live on a fast, predictable timeline
* Shipped wins with documented ROI, and a clear view of where the team needs to grow next

**What You Bring**

* **Proven leadership:** 7+ years in automation, development, data, or technical operations, including 3+ years leading a technical team with direct reports — coaching, accountability, and running a delivery cadence
* **You’ve built the playbook:** a track record of putting SOPs, operating rhythms, and KPIs in place for a team that didn’t have them — and getting people to actually follow them
* Experience leading people more technical than you — you set outcomes and check progress without micromanaging
* Shipped AI, automation, or software that moved a measurable number — not pilots and slide decks
* Strong technical grounding in the Microsoft stack (M365/Azure, Power Platform, Power BI), APIs, and integrations — enough to unblock, review, and build when needed
* Comfortable in client-facing work, including tough conversations around data, security, and compliance
* Strong business translation — you turn “we need X” from non-technical stakeholders into a delivered solution
* Thrives in a lean, fast-moving environment — candidates who need heavy corporate structure won’t be the right fit

**Nice to Have**

* MSP, SaaS, or multi-client service experience
* Background in software product delivery or data/BI leadership

**Benefits:**
=============

* Nationwide medical insurance.
* Dental insurance.
* Life insurance gifted to all employees.
* Long-term disability insurance gifted to all employees.
* FSA and HSA options.
* Generous paid time off.
* Mental health days
* $500 sign on bonus
* Paid certification assistance

**We are an Equal Opportunity Employer!**

Compensation Range: $150K - $180K

Title: Head of Enterprise Architecture
Description:
Medica is a nonprofit health plan with more than a million members that serves communities in Minnesota, Nebraska, Wisconsin, Missouri, and beyond. We deliver personalized health care experiences and partner closely with providers to ensure members are genuinely cared for.

We're a team that owns our work with accountability, makes data-driven decisions, embraces continuous learning, and celebrates collaboration — because success is a team sport. It's our mission to be there in the moments that matter most for our members and employees. Join us in creating a community of connected care, where coordinated, quality service is the norm and every member feels valued.

The Head of Enterprise Architecture (HEA) is responsible for establishing and leading Medica's enterprise architecture organization and ensuring Medica’s enterprise architecture aligns and enables, our business strategy, operating capabilities, technology, data, and processes, resulting in measurable and increasing enterprise value. Reporting directly to the Chief Information Officer, the HEA serves as a strategic advisor to the CIO and senior business and technology leaders and leads a multidisciplinary architecture organization spanning enterprise, business, security, data, integration, and related architecture disciplines. The HEA also leads an enterprise-wide Architecture Community of Practice to align architects and architecture-adjacent roles around common principles, standards, methods, patterns, and decision practices.

Business Architecture is a foundational discipline of the practice. The HEA ensures a clear understanding of enterprise business objectives, the current and required state of business capabilities, and the value-aligned roadmaps needed to move from current to target state. These roadmaps integrate changes across technology, data, processes, organization, skills, and operating models. The role partners closely with the Office of the CIO, Enterprise Transformation, Business Process Re-engineering, Product Ownership, Engineering, Data, Security, and business leadership to translate strategy into executable change.

The HEA will evolve Enterprise Architecture from a traditional, centralized governance model toward an enabling, embedded, and delivery-oriented practice. Architecture will engage earlier and more deeply in strategic and day-to-day delivery, using reusable standards, reference architectures, patterns, guardrails, and risk-based decision frameworks to accelerate sound decisions. The HEA will also advance AI-enabled architecture practices to automate routine documentation, analysis, standards validation, knowledge management, and governance activities so architects can focus on solving critical business problems, transformation, complex design decisions, and delivery enablement.

**Key Accountabilities**

**Structure and Advance Enterprise Architecture Practices**

* Establish and continuously evolve the enterprise architecture strategy, operating model, principles, standards, methods, and practices.
* Establish Business Architecture as the connective layer between enterprise strategy, transformation, product portfolios, business processes, organizational design, data, and technology.
* Ensure development and maintenance of enterprise business capability models; partner to assess current-state maturity and identify capability gaps, dependencies, duplication, and investment needs.
* Translate enterprise strategy and business objectives into target states, transition states, and value-aligned capability roadmaps integrating changes to people, process, technology, data, organization, skills, and operating models.
* Provide enterprise leaders with clear views of strategic dependencies, tradeoffs, sequencing, technical health, and investment implications.
* Ensure technology strategy is traceable to business strategy and capability requirements.

**Deliver Enterprise Transformation & Strategy through Architecture**

* Serve as a strategic architecture advisor to the CIO, executive leadership, Transformation, Product, and business leaders.
* Partner with Enterprise Transformation and Business Process Re-engineering to connect strategic objectives, transformation portfolios, and process redesign to required business-capability changes.
* Partner with Product Owners and Product Management to connect enterprise capability roadmaps with product strategies, investment priorities, and delivery roadmaps.
* Ensure architecture strategy reflects the operating, regulatory, data, and interoperability requirements of a healthcare organization, with particular emphasis on the health plan/payer environment.
* Provide architectural leadership for healthcare interoperability and industry standards, including X12 EDI, HL7 FHIR, USCDI, and other applicable healthcare information-exchange standards.
* Translate regulatory and interoperability requirements into enterprise capabilities and strategic roadmaps in partnership with Compliance, Legal, Security, Privacy, Product, Data, and business leaders.

**Architecture Enablement & Governance**

* Modernize the Architecture Review process from a primarily centralized approval mechanism into a risk-based architecture enablement model embedded earlier in strategy, discovery, design, and delivery.
* Establish reference architectures, reusable patterns, standards, guardrails, decision frameworks, and architecture decision records that increase delivery autonomy while maintaining enterprise alignment.
* Define clear decision rights across Enterprise Architecture, domain architecture, solution architecture, Engineering, Product, Security, Data, and related functions.
* Partner with engineering and technology leaders to evaluate and select strategic platforms, core technologies, architectural patterns, and engineering approaches.
* Guide modernization of core capabilities including Cloud, APIs, integration, data platforms, automation, AI, SaaS, and digital capabilities while reducing unnecessary complexity, duplication, and technical debt.
* Use AI and automation to improve architecture knowledge discovery, documentation, standards validation, impact analysis, dependency identification, and governance workflows, freeing architects for higher-value work.
* Measure architecture effectiveness through business outcomes, delivery enablement, reuse, simplification, risk reduction, technology health, and decision quality.

**Architecture Team Leadership**

* Lead, develop, and mentor a multidisciplinary architecture organization spanning enterprise, business, security, data, integration, and related architecture disciplines.
* Establish and lead an enterprise-wide Architecture Community of Practice encompassing architects and architecture-adjacent roles across centralized and distributed teams.
* Define common architecture principles, terminology, methods, artifacts, modeling approaches, standards, and expectations across the organization.
* Create mechanisms for knowledge sharing, reusable solutions, emerging practices, and lessons learned across the architecture community.
* Develop architecture talent, competency models, career paths, succession plans, and leadership capability across the enterprise.
* Build an architecture culture based on influence, transparency, collaboration, practical guidance, and accountability rather than centralized control.
* Operate effectively from executive strategy through delivery-level architecture, communicating complex business and technology concepts to technical and nontechnical audiences.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 15+ years of progressively responsible experience across enterprise technology, architecture, business transformation, engineering, or related disciplines; significant leadership experience building and leading enterprise or domain architecture functions in complex organizations.
* 5+ years of people management experience leading highly technical roles in direct, indirect, and contractor roles.
* Business capability modeling and capability-based planning; strategy-to-execution alignment; value-stream and operating-model analysis; enterprise transformation and roadmap development; architecture governance and operating models; modern cloud, API, integration, data, security, SaaS, automation, and AI architectures; healthcare interoperability; executive communication, facilitation, organizational change, stakeholder influence, and talent development

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline preferred.
* Experience managing vendor relationships.
* Healthcare payer / managed care experience strongly preferred; broader healthcare experience considered.

Description:

We are Optimum, a leader in the fast-paced world of connectivity, and we're seeking driven and enthusiastic professionals to join our team, empower lives, fuel businesses, and drive innovation. Connectivity is no longer a luxury, but a necessity. A career at Optimum means you'll be enabling progress and enhancing lives by providing reliable, high-speed connectivity solutions that keep the world connected. Our successes, now and in the future, are powered by our amazing product, a commitment to our people and culture, and the connections we make in our communities.

If you are resourceful, collaborative, and passionate about delivering consistent excellence, Optimum is for you!

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Telecommunications Core Manager SRE will lead the Mobile Core, Voice Routing, Translations, and DNS teams supporting Optimum Mobile and related voice and network services. This role is accountable for day-to-day operational excellence, delivery of projects and platform enhancements, and the development of engineering talent across IMS/mobile core, voice routing, call/number translation, and DNS platforms. The Manager applies site reliability engineering practices to ensure carrier-grade reliability, performance, and customer experience, and partners closely with senior leadership, vendors, Network Operations, Product, Security, and cross-functional engineering teams.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop engineers across the Mobile Core, Voice Routing, Translations, and DNS teams; set priorities, balance workload, and build succession and cross-training plans.
* Provide hands-on people management: performance coaching, career development, hiring/onboarding, workload planning, and clear accountability across multi-discipline engineering teams.
* Own operational health and reliability of assigned platforms: define and track KPIs/SLIs/SLOs where applicable, alarm triage, capacity awareness, and proactive identification of trends that could impact customers.
* Lead dimensioning activities for mobile core, voice routing, translation, and DNS platforms, including capacity planning, traffic/query forecasting, and ensuring platforms are sized for growth and peak demand.
* Drive automation initiatives to reduce operational TOIL across monitoring, provisioning, failover, recovery, and repetitive engineering workflows; improve resilience and speed of delivery.
* Oversee DNS platform reliability and operations supporting core and voice services (authoritative/recursive DNS, record lifecycle, monitoring, and incident response), in partnership with DNS engineering and adjacent teams.
* Ensure platforms and processes align with applicable FCC standards and regulatory requirements for voice and mobile services.
* Oversee STI (Secure Telephone Identity) / STIR/SHAKEN and robocalling mitigation capabilities, including attestation, verification, and related routing/call-authentication controls in partnership with vendors and internal stakeholders.
* Support and improve critical public-safety and mandated services including E911 and 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) routing, testing, and operational readiness.
* Drive incident and outage response for the areas of responsibility, including vendor engagement, escalation management, clear stakeholder communication, and post-incident RCA / corrective actions.
* Plan and oversee maintenance windows, upgrades, releases, and acceptance testing for mobile core, voice routing, translation/routing, and DNS systems; ensure changes follow change-management and rollback readiness practices.
* Partner with vendors and internal stakeholders to implement new features, network functions, and optimizations that improve quality of experience for voice and mobile customers.
* Provide technical and managerial guidance on IMS / mobile core platforms (e.g., SBC, CSCF, TAS, HSS/HLR, related EPC/5GC touchpoints), voice routing / translation services (SIP/IMS call routing, digit and number translations, related signaling), and DNS services supporting those platforms.
* Ensure second-level support quality for escalated customer and network issues; improve runbooks, monitoring, and handoffs with NOC / service assurance.
* Establish and track team goals and reporting for leadership (availability, incidents, project status, risk).
* Recruit, interview, and onboard talent; foster an inclusive, collaborative culture focused on results, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Occasionally support after-hours maintenance, major releases, and critical outages as needed for leadership coverage.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience
* 5+ years of experience in mobile core, IMS, voice services, and/or DNS/network infrastructure engineering within a service-provider or large-scale telecom/ISP environment

Title: Sr. Manager, Enterprise Data (R6103)
Description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. ### **Job Description:**

The Sr. Manager, Enterprise Data is responsible for leading delivery across Shield AI’s Enterprise Data team as the organization enables business domains onto its governed Databricks data platform.

This role manages the engineers and delivery work required to turn enterprise data strategy into usable, reliable data products. The Sr. Manager will establish effective delivery rhythms, guide domain prioritization, manage capacity and dependencies, and ensure that business needs are translated into clear, appropriately scoped work for the Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Domain Enablement, and Data Governance functions.

The role requires substantial data and analytics depth to assess delivery approaches, challenge unclear requirements, make appropriate tradeoffs, and ensure that the team produces durable, governed, production-ready outcomes rather than one-off reporting solutions.

The Sr. Manager partners closely with the Sr. Director of Enterprise Data & Architecture on strategy, operating model, investment priorities, executive engagement, and cross-functional alignment. The role partners with Platform Engineering and Enterprise Architecture, which remain direct functions of the Sr. Director, to ensure domain delivery is built on secure, reliable, scalable enterprise foundations.

**What you'll do:**

* Lead and develop the Enterprise Data delivery team, including Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Domain Enablement Engineers, and Data Governance specialists.
* Establish clear delivery operating rhythms for planning, prioritization, capacity management, roadmap tracking, dependency management, risk escalation, and stakeholder communication.
* Turn enterprise data strategy and business-domain priorities into sequenced, achievable delivery plans across platform onboarding, source integration, data-product delivery, semantic enablement, and governance.
* Partner with business leaders and domain stakeholders to shape intake, clarify intended outcomes, assess readiness, prioritize use cases, and establish realistic delivery expectations.
* Ensure domain work is appropriately scoped and sequenced, balancing near-term business value with the need for durable, governed, reusable data foundations.
* Coordinate delivery across Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Domain Enablement, and Data Governance; resolve dependencies and escalate decisions that require platform, architecture, security, infrastructure, or executive direction.
* Ensure team outputs meet expectations for production readiness, data quality, documentation, ownership, lineage, security, access controls, and maintainability.
* Review delivery plans, technical approaches, risks, and tradeoffs with technical leads; challenge work that creates unnecessary duplication, ungoverned data assets, or unsustainable operational burden.
* Partner with the Sr. Staff Data Engineer to align domain delivery to shared ingestion, transformation, and deployment patterns.
* Partner with the Staff Analytics Engineer to ensure domain assets align to enterprise semantic standards, metric definitions, and Gold-layer promotion expectations.
* Partner with the Platform / Data Reliability Engineer to ensure domain workloads meet platform standards for reliability, observability, cost management, environment promotion, and secure production operation.
* Partner with the Data Governance Specialist to ensure ownership, stewardship, classifications, metadata, lineage, quality expectations, and approvals are incorporated into delivery work.
* Hire, coach, develop, and retain a high-performing data team; establish role clarity, growth expectations, performance feedback, and appropriate technical leadership opportunities.
* Define and monitor practical measures of delivery health, including roadmap progress, throughput, time to enable new domains, adoption, quality trends, operational stability, and unresolved dependencies.
* Communicate delivery progress, material risks, investment needs, and tradeoffs clearly to business and technology leadership.
* Continuously improve the team’s delivery model as the enterprise data platform, domain portfolio, and organizational maturity evolve.

**Required qualifications:**

* 12+ years of experience across data engineering, analytics engineering, BI/data platforms, data architecture, or related technical data disciplines.
* 3+ years of experience leading and developing technical teams responsible for data, analytics, data products, or data-platform delivery.
* Demonstrated success leading delivery across multiple business domains and balancing competing stakeholder priorities.
* Strong understanding of modern data-platform concepts, including lakehouse architecture, data pipelines, Bronze/Silver/Gold patterns, dimensional modeling, semantic layers, data quality, metadata, lineage, and governed access.
* Hands-on experience with Databricks, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, Workflows, or related lakehouse capabilities.
* Ability to assess and challenge technical delivery approaches without needing to be the primary hands-on implementer for every solution.
* Experience translating business priorities into outcome-oriented roadmaps, scoped delivery plans, and realistic sequencing decisions.
* Experience partnering with business stakeholders, software engineering, cloud/infrastructure, security, governance, and architecture functions.
* Strong judgment in ambiguous, fast-moving environments with incomplete information and competing demands.
* Strong communication, organizational leadership, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience building or scaling an enterprise data function, data-product operating model, or multi-domain analytics platform.
* Experience leading data delivery for Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Finance, Program Finance, GTM, HR, Engineering, or other complex enterprise domains.
* Experience in aerospace, defense, autonomous systems, manufacturing, government, or another regulated and security-sensitive environment.
* Experience leading platform migrations, modernizations, ERP transformations, or enterprise data operating-model change.
* Experience managing distributed, remote, partner, or blended internal/external delivery teams.

Title: VP/Director of Channel Partnerships
Description:
**About Harmony**

Harmony gives every employee an always-on expert for every service request, inside the tools they already use. Deployed inside Slack and Microsoft Teams, its agents draw on a context graph connecting each employee's identity, devices, applications, and history, resolving requests across IT, HR, finance, procurement, and legal automatically, before a ticket ever opens.

With 100+ prebuilt agents that deploy in days, not months, and a 70% no-touch resolution rate, Harmony removes the manual work from enterprise service without removing the humans who should own the hard problems. Built for IT and HR teams that are done waiting for their service platform to catch up with the rest of the business.

**About the Role**
------------------

This is Harmony's first Director of Channel Partnerships. You'll own the strategy, programs, and relationships that make partners a meaningful source of Harmony's pipeline and revenue. You'll be a hands-on builder: recruiting and managing partners, closing partner-sourced deals alongside our Account Executives, and putting the program foundation in place as you go. The role is accountable to pipeline generation, quota attainment and revenue growth goals - driving sales outcomes through partnerships.

You won't be starting from a blank page. Harmony already has active reseller partners generating pipeline and closed revenue, 100+ live product integrations with category-leading platforms across identity, device management, security, HRIS, and knowledge management, and a live AWS Marketplace listing. What's missing is the formal program around that momentum: tiering, partner agreements, deal registration, enablement, and named alliance relationships. Building that is your job.

The AI-native enterprise service management category is still being sorted into winners, and partners are choosing which vendors to standardize on right now. A focused, credible partner program is a competitive advantage, and you will build it with discipline: a small number of well-matched, well-enabled partners rather than a large roster of inactive ones.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Own channel and alliances strategy**

* Own and evolve Harmony's channels and alliances strategy across resellers, system integrators (SI), managed service providers (MSP), distributors, technology alliances, and cloud marketplaces
* Define ideal partner profiles (geography, vertical, size, and capabilities) and build ranked target lists for each partner type
* Sequence the build-out in phases matched to Harmony's stage, and set clear targets for partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue
* Build the business case for partner investments, including incentives and marketing development funds (MDF)

**Build and scale the reseller and SI/MSP channel**

* Formalize and grow our existing reseller relationships, using what works today as the template for what comes next
* Recruit a focused set of new resellers, SIs, and MSPs against explicit partner criteria, and drive each to its first closed deal quickly
* Design and launch a simple, tiered partner program (starting with authorized and premier reseller tiers) with clear margins, requirements, and benefits
* Create the partner agreement, deal registration process, and rules of engagement between partners and our direct sales team
* Partner with Account Executives and Solution Engineers to co-sell and close partner-sourced opportunities

**Turn technology integrations into alliances**

* Convert Harmony's highest-value existing integrations into named alliance relationships with joint go-to-market listings, co-marketing, and co-selling motions
* Prioritize alliance partners based on prevalence in our customer base and category leadership
* Secure listings in partner marketplaces and directories, and build joint content and campaigns with Marketing
* Work with Product and Engineering on integration priorities that strengthen alliance relationships

**Activate cloud marketplace co-sell**

* Activate Harmony's AWS Marketplace listing and private offer motion so customers can buy Harmony against their existing cloud commitments
* Build co-sell relationships with hyperscaler partner teams and evaluate additional marketplaces as demand warrants

**Enable partners and run partner operations**

* Build partner onboarding, sales and technical enablement, and certification, in partnership with Solution Engineering and Customer Engineering
* Partner with Revenue Operations to track partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue natively in Salesforce
* Report on partner performance, including partner-sourced revenue as a share of total, active partners, and time-to-first-deal for new partners
* Evolve tiering, tooling, and a partner portal as the program scales

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 8+ years in channel sales, partnerships, or alliances at a B2B, IT-focused SaaS company, with at least 3 years in a senior or lead role
* Track record of building a channel or alliance program from early stage, not only managing a mature one
* Proven results recruiting, enabling, and growing resellers, VARs, or MSPs into consistent sources of partner-sourced revenue
* Experience building technology alliances with ISVs, including joint go-to-market, co-marketing, and co-selling
* Hands-on experience designing partner program structures, agreements, margins, and deal registration - while also being an expert at managing and minimizing channel conflict
* Strong commercial skills and comfort carrying a number and closing deals in partnership with our direct sales teams - our channel motion will be fully integrated with our AE and SE teams (joint selling)
* Excellent marketing collaboration skills and the ability to influence and/or drive partner marketing and investment programs (e.g. MDF)
* Strong analytical skills and comfort with SaaS and partner metrics (ARR, pipeline coverage, partner-sourced vs. influenced revenue)
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including presenting to executives and partner leadership
* Comfort with ambiguity and full ownership as a hands-on individual contributor
* Able to work from our New York City office on a hybrid schedule

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience at an early-stage B2B SaaS company (Seed to Series C), ideally as the first channel or partnerships hire
* Experience in ITSM, ESM, or AI-native service management, or with partners in that ecosystem
* Existing relationships with resellers, MSPs, or alliance teams at identity, device management, security, or HRIS platforms
* Experience with AWS Marketplace private offers and hyperscaler co-sell programs
* Experience supporting international partners (EMEA and Israel)
* Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce partner management, Gong, and partner relationship management (PRM) platforms

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive salary and equity
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k), with company matching
* Top-tier in-office gear, and
* Many more

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.*

Compensation Range: $240K - $340K
