Title: AIR FREIGHT PRICING AND OPERATIONS MANAGER
Description:
Air Freight Operations & Pricing Manager

**Company:** Unique Courier Cargo Services LLC  
**Location:** Dubai, UAE  
**Department:** Air Freight Operations & Pricing  
**Position Level:** Senior Management  
**Reports To:** Directors & Management

Job Overview

Unique Courier Cargo Services LLC is seeking a **highly experienced, commercially driven, and result-oriented Air Freight Operations & Pricing Manager** to take complete ownership of the company's air freight operations, pricing, airline relationships, and business development opportunities.

We are looking for a strong leader with extensive knowledge of international air freight, transshipment operations, airline pricing, and CMC (Cargo Mega Terminal) facilities and their potential business opportunities.

The selected candidate must be capable of independently managing the entire operations and pricing team, maintaining strong airline relationships, maximizing enquiry conversions, ensuring operational excellence, and taking full accountability for departmental performance.

**This is an ownership-driven leadership position, not merely an operational supervisory role.**

Key Responsibilities

**1. Complete Operations Management & Accountability**

* Take full responsibility for the day-to-day performance of the Air Freight Operations and Pricing Department.
* Lead, supervise, train, and guide the entire operations and pricing team.
* Ensure every customer enquiry is properly reviewed, priced, followed up, and converted wherever commercially feasible.
* Take complete accountability for all enquiries, quotations, bookings, shipment execution, and operational escalations.
* Establish clear responsibilities, productivity standards, and performance expectations for each team member.
* Ensure timely shipment execution, accurate documentation, regulatory compliance, and effective coordination with all stakeholders.
* Independently resolve operational challenges and implement preventive measures.

**2. Airline Relationships & Pricing Management**

* Maintain excellent working relationships with major airlines, GSAs, cargo terminals, and handling agents.
* Negotiate competitive freight rates, special rates, allotments, and commercial arrangements.
* Possess strong knowledge of airline networks, routing options, capacity availability, and international cargo regulations.
* Develop effective pricing strategies to improve both conversion rates and gross profitability.
* Build direct relationships with airline decision-makers to secure commercially advantageous opportunities.
* Continuously monitor market rates, competitor pricing, and airline developments.

**3. Transshipment & CMC Business Development**

* Demonstrate extensive knowledge of international cargo transshipment operations through Dubai and other major hubs.
* Identify and develop business opportunities involving CMC facilities, cargo consolidation, transit cargo, and cross-border freight movements.
* Develop commercially viable solutions for cargo movements through Dubai, including documentation, handling, routing, and regulatory requirements.
* Establish relationships with international freight forwarding agents and overseas business partners.
* Identify new trade lanes, airline partnerships, and transshipment business opportunities.
* Present practical business development proposals to management, including revenue potential, expected margins, operational requirements, and implementation plans.

**4. Enquiry Management & 95% Conversion Target**

* Drive the department toward a **target of 95% conversion of qualified, commercially viable enquiries**.
* Ensure 100% of enquiries are recorded, assigned, monitored, and followed up.
* Implement a structured quotation and follow-up system to minimize lost business.
* Analyze unsuccessful quotations and identify the reasons for lost business.
* Ensure quotations are competitive, accurate, profitable, and delivered within established turnaround times.
* Work closely with the Sales Department to convert enquiries into confirmed shipments.
* Take ownership of improving enquiry quality, quotation efficiency, customer retention, and shipment volumes.

**5. Weekly Management Reporting**

Submit a detailed weekly performance report to management covering:

* Total enquiries received, quotations submitted, and shipments confirmed.
* Enquiry conversion percentage and comparison against the 95% target.
* Total sales revenue and gross profit generated.
* Shipment volumes, chargeable weight, and major trade lanes.
* Lost enquiries, reasons for non-conversion, and corrective actions.
* Airline rate developments and negotiated commercial benefits.
* Individual team performance, productivity, and accountability.
* Operational issues, shipment delays, and resolutions.
* New business opportunities, particularly in transshipment and CMC operations.
* Action plan for the coming week with measurable targets.

The Manager must be able to **explain departmental performance, identify shortcomings, and present actionable solutions rather than merely report figures.**

**6. Leadership & Professional Representation**

* Represent the company professionally in meetings with airlines, customers, international agents, and business partners.
* Maintain excellent personal presentation, professional grooming, communication, and business etiquette.
* Demonstrate confidence, strong negotiation capabilities, commercial awareness, and sound decision-making.
* Conduct regular departmental performance meetings and ensure effective team coordination.
* Develop employees through training, mentoring, and practical operational guidance.
* Demonstrate leadership through ownership, discipline, accountability, and consistent performance.
* Act as the primary escalation point for air freight operational and pricing matters.

Candidate Requirements

* Minimum **8–10 years of relevant experience** in air freight forwarding, operations, and pricing, preferably within the UAE market.
* At least 3–5 years in a managerial or senior leadership position.
* Established professional relationships with airlines, GSAs, and air cargo handling agents in the UAE.
* Strong expertise in transshipment operations, Dubai air cargo facilities, CMC-related opportunities, and cargo handling procedures.
* Excellent knowledge of import, export, transit cargo, customs procedures, AWB documentation, and airline regulations.
* Working knowledge of IATA regulations, dangerous goods procedures, and international freight forwarding practices.
* Proven ability to negotiate competitive airline rates and develop profitable freight solutions.
* Demonstrated experience managing operational teams and improving enquiry conversion rates.
* Strong analytical, reporting, communication, and commercial negotiation skills.
* Excellent command of English, both written and spoken.
* Professional appearance, leadership presence, and ability to represent the company at senior-level meetings.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership, and deliver measurable results with minimal supervision.

The successful candidate will be expected to operate with the mindset of a **Department Head and Business Leader**, taking responsibility not only for completing shipments but also for building a highly efficient, profitable, and commercially competitive Air Freight Department.

Management expects someone who can independently identify problems, provide solutions, generate opportunities, develop the team, and deliver measurable improvements in operational performance and profitability.

**We are looking for a strong, decisive, hands-on leader who takes complete ownership of the department, builds lasting airline relationships, drives business growth, and is accountable for results.**

Title: Associate Portfolio Manager, Public Credit
Description:
At IMCO, our talent is among the best! IMCO offers a uniquely stimulating and rewarding environment where you can help build and drive organizational transformation, all while seeking to challenge yourself, learn, and grow your career.

Our culture is built on collaboration and passion, with a shared commitment to delivering lasting value to the clients we serve. Located in downtown Toronto, our vision is to be the partner of choice for Ontario’s public sector funds and to build a high-performing, value-driven asset management firm.

This job posting is for an existing vacancy. If you are ready to deliver best-in-class service and join a collaborative, motivated and fun team of professionals, IMCO offers the opportunity to do impactful work and broaden your expertise.

If you’re looking to use your expertise to drive strategic outcomes, we’d love to hear from you.

‎

IMCO’s actively managed Global Credit strategy (~$10.1B AUM) delivers higher risk-adjusted returns through a unified approach to credit investing, integrating public and private credit within a single, globally diversified portfolio. The strategy adopts a holistic approach to portfolio construction, allocating across public credit segments, including investment grade, high yield, leveraged loans, and structured credit, alongside private credit segments to capture relative value opportunities, enhance diversification, and optimize liquidity and return outcomes across market cycles.

Our collaborative culture and value-add approach to strategic partnerships makes us a preferred partner to some of the largest investors in the world. We have a targeted strategy to grow our highly diversified Global Credit portfolio and are looking for a highly motivated Associate Portfolio Manager to join our Global Credit team with a focus on public credit!

The Associate Portfolio Manager, Public Credit will play a key role in managing IMCO’s externally managed Public Credit portfolio, with responsibilities spanning manager selection and due diligence, portfolio strategy and construction, and ongoing monitoring and oversight. The role combines rigorous investment analysis with active portfolio management, while also contributing to ongoing initiatives to enhance the Global Credit platform and target operating model, including the implementation of investment systems and processes and the development of advanced analytics and AI capabilities to improve portfolio insights and support investment decision-making.

**As a Member of Our Global Credit Team, You Will Contribute Across Three Core Areas: Manager Selection & Oversight, Portfolio Management and Strategy, and Platform Enhancement:**

* Provide analytical and portfolio management support to the Managing Director in overseeing externally managed public credit portfolios on a day-to-day basis, including ad hoc analysis and strategic initiatives.
* Source, screen, and conduct due diligence on external public credit managers across strategies (e.g., investment grade, high yield, loans and structured credit), utilizing data platforms and AI-enabled tools to analyze performance, identify risks, and support manager screening and ongoing evaluation.
* Lead and support the preparation of investment recommendations, including drafting investment memos and presentations for internal Investment Committee approval.
* Assist in structuring and negotiating investment mandates, guidelines, and negotiating fee arrangements with external managers in collaboration with risk, legal and other internal teams.
* Conduct ongoing monitoring of external managers, including performance attribution, risk exposures, style drift, and adherence to investment guidelines; leverage AI to enhance efficiency in analysis, identify performance and risk trends, and support the development of portfolio-level reporting and insights for senior management.
* Lead or contribute to initiatives within Global Credit to enhance portfolio management infrastructure through the application of AI and the integration of new investment systems and analytics capabilities; partner with internal teams (Risk, Performance, Operations, Technology) to improve investment data quality to enable more effective analysis, reporting, and decision-making.

Title: SVP, Head of Identity & Access Management
Description:
***Lead with Purpose, Unlock Your Team’s Passion***

At LPL, people leaders hold the key to the employee experience — shaping culture, driving performance, and guiding individuals to new heights. Because when that happens, we all win – clients, LPL, and most importantly our, employees.

If you're ready to lead with intention and discover what’s possible, LPL Financial invites you to apply today.

**Position Summary**

The Senior Vice President, Identity & Access Management (IAM) is responsible for leading LPL Financial's enterprise IAM organization and advancing the firm's identity security strategy, governance, engineering, operations, and resiliency capabilities.

This executive leader oversees all aspects of workforce, advisor, partner, and privileged identity management, ensuring secure and compliant access to firm resources while enabling business growth and digital transformation. The SVP will lead a large-scale IAM organization responsible for Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Authentication Services, Directory Services, Identity Engineering, Production Support, and Identity Platform Operations. The role will also drive modernization efforts focused on Zero Trust principles, operational resilience, automation, cloud identity services, and regulatory compliance.

Reporting directly to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), this position will partner closely with Technology, Infrastructure, Enterprise Architecture, Risk Management, Compliance, Internal Audit, Human Capital, and business leaders across the organization.

**What You'll Do**

**Enterprise IAM Leadership**

* Lead the vision, strategy, and execution of LPL's Identity & Access Management program.
* Establish a multi-year IAM roadmap aligned to Cybersecurity and Technology priorities.
* Serve as the senior leader accountable for IAM operations, platform stability, service delivery, and risk management.
* Drive continuous improvement of identity controls, governance processes, and operational effectiveness.
* Develop and maintain executive-level reporting on IAM risks, priorities, performance, and organizational health.

**Identity Security & Governance**

* Lead Identity Governance and Administration programs, including provisioning, deprovisioning, access certification, role management, and segregation-of-duties controls.
* Ensure adherence to least-privilege and Zero Trust security principles across the enterprise.
* Establish IAM policies, standards, and governance frameworks.
* Partner with Risk and Compliance teams to ensure alignment with regulatory and audit requirements.

**Platform Engineering & Operations**

* Oversee IAM engineering, production support, and operational teams responsible for enterprise identity platforms.
* Lead modernization efforts across Ping Identity, ForgeRock, Active Directory, Entra ID, authentication services, federation, and Single Sign-On capabilities.
* Ensure scalability, resiliency, and operational excellence across critical identity infrastructure.
* Drive automation and reduction of manual operational processes to improve reliability and risk management.

**Privileged Access Management**

* Lead strategy and governance for privileged access across users, systems, applications, and service accounts.
* Strengthen access controls through centralized governance, monitoring, and least-privileged access models.
* Ensure effective controls over administrative and elevated access activities.

**Operational Resilience & Stability**

* Own resilience and availability strategies for critical IAM platforms and services.
* Lead initiatives related to disaster recovery, high availability, identity provider resiliency, and business continuity planning.
* Partner with Architecture and Engineering teams to improve platform reliability and reduce operational risk.
* Establish metrics and accountability frameworks supporting production stability and change governance.

**Organizational Leadership**

* Lead and develop a high-performing organization consisting of leaders, architects, engineers, analysts, and support professionals.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Develop succession plans and organizational capabilities to support future growth.
* Manage budgets, vendor relationships, workforce planning, and strategic investments.

**Executive Comportment**

* Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where scale, priorities, and organizational structure evolve quickly.
* Balances pace and pragmatism with disciplined risk management, favoring practical progress over process for its own sake.
* Builds trust and credibility quickly across a highly matrixed organization, earning confidence from business partners, technology peers, auditors, and regulators alike.
* Leads confidently through ambiguity, translating strategic intent into action even where processes or org structures are still maturing.
* Is a visible, hands-on leader who is equally comfortable stepping back to coach, empower, and grow the team as the organization scales.
* Brings resilience and an ownership mindset, adapting readily as business priorities, regulatory expectations, and the threat landscape shift.
* Communicates with transparency and executive presence, building confidence with senior leadership, the Board, and regulators.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in cybersecurity, identity management, or enterprise technology.
* 8+ years leading large-scale IAM, cybersecurity, or security engineering organizations.
* Deep expertise in:
  + Identity Governance & Administration (IGA)
  + Privileged Access Management (PAM)
  + Single Sign-On (SSO)
  + Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
  + Federation and authentication platforms
  + Directory Services and cloud identity technologies
* Experience leading enterprise transformation and modernization programs.
* Demonstrated success managing large, geographically dispersed technical organizations.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience within financial services, wealth management, banking, brokerage, or other highly regulated industries.
* Experience with Ping Identity, ForgeRock, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, CyberArk, or related identity technologies.
* Master's degree in a related field.
* CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CGEIT, or equivalent certifications

Title: Carrier Certification Manager
Description:
**About Eagle Wireless**
Eagle Wireless is building the connective tissue of the physical world.
  
  
Every connected car, every industrial sensor, every IoT device that needs to talk to the cloud reliably and securely — that’s where we come in. We design and deliver cellular modules and connectivity solutions that automotive, and IoT companies trust to work for years, in the field, without compromise.
  
  
Our teams span North America, Europe, and APAC, giving you the chance to collaborate with world-class engineers and go-to-market experts solving hard problems at global scale — from cybersecurity and supply chain resilience to regulatory compliance across dozens of markets.
  
  
If you want your work to matter in a world that’s rapidly connecting everything, and you want to do it alongside people obsessed with getting the hard stuff right, Eagle Wireless is where that happens.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Carrier Certification Manager will own Eagle's end-to-end carrier certification program across the US and Canada. This includes managing active certification projects, building and maintaining carrier relationships, and working cross-functionally with product, engineering, and sales to ensure Eagle's modules achieve and maintain certification across all major networks. This role is essential to Eagle's product commercialization timeline and go-to-market readiness.
  
  
**Key Requirements**

* Manage active carrier certification programs across AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile (US), and Telus, Rogers, Bell (Canada), ensuring on-time completion.
* Serve as Eagle's primary point of contact with carrier certification teams and labs; build and maintain trusted relationships with carrier ecosystem managers.

* Own the certification project tracker and communicate progress, risks, and timelines to product management and executive leadership.
* Manage certification costs, budgets, and vendor relationships (third-party test labs, certification bodies).
* Oversee PTCRB, GCF, FCC/IC, and ISED submissions that feed into carrier certification eligibility.
* Monitor carrier certification policy changes, new requirements, and network evolution (e.g., 5G Standalone, Network Slicing) and proactively update Eagle's certification strategy.
* Support the sales team by clearly communicating certification status and timelines for customer RFQs and design-in decisions.
* Develop and maintain certification documentation, including test reports and compliance records.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in carrier certification, regulatory compliance, or technical program management within the wireless, module, or device ecosystem.
* Direct experience managing AT&T, Verizon, or T-Mobile certification processes; Canadian carrier experience is a plus.
* Understanding of PTCRB, GCF, FCC/IC certification frameworks and their interplay with carrier certification.
* Strong project management skills; ability to run multiple certification programs in parallel.
* Excellent cross-functional communication skills with engineering, product, and sales stakeholders.
* Experience with cellular module certification specifically (as opposed to device/handset only).
* Familiarity with 5G NR certification requirements and how they differ from LTE.
* Knowledge of ISED (Canada), FirstNet, and MVNO certification requirements.
* Experience working with third-party test labs.
* Flexible to attend occasional early-morning or evening calls to coordinate with teams in Asia (UTC+8).
* Willing to travel occasionally to carrier or third-party laboratories to provide on-site support as needed.

**Our work environment is collaborative, and we offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, which includes medical/dental/vision, generous PTO and paid parental leave programs.**

Title: BMW Program Manager
Description:
**Duties & Responsibilities**

* Support quarterly adjustments to the training plan.
* Support the planning of Focus Training and coaching.
* Manage programme risks, issues and changes, and communicate their impact on scope, timelines, resources and cost.
* Maintain programme documentation, decisions and action logs.
* Maintain a formal improvement tracker of all proposals tabled with BMW, together with BMW's responses.
* Record and track all new projects delivered by or via GP, and all value-added services.
* Lead GP's participation in audits, programme reviews and BMW governance activities.

**Client Meetings & Reporting**

* Run the weekly operations meeting with the team, covering priorities, delivery status and actions.
* Chair the monthly client meeting with BMW, covering performance, KPIs, SLA results and the forward plan.
* Lead the quarterly account meeting with BMW, including review of annual volumetrics, capacity assumptions and demand trends.
* Review all reports and the monthly KPI scoreboard before they are sent to BMW.
* Own and sign off the monthly SLA report, and chair the monthly joint review of the SLA exception register with BMW.
* Keep BMW and the BMW RO informed of successes and noteworthy stories, and maintain a success log with evidence.

**Financial Control**

* Prepare annual budget inputs, including training volumes, trainer mix and costs, for the Senior Director, who sets rates and agrees the budget with BMW.
* Control all programme financials against the approved budget, including spend, variance and BMW over- or under-spend, and escalate commercial risks.
* Prepare the monthly forward forecast of revenue, vendor cost and training volumes.
* Control GP revenue recovery: sign off monthly BMW invoicing so that all billable activity is recovered, and reconcile SLA credit deductions.
* Reconcile vendor costs against BMW invoicing every month.
* Support the maintenance of the training tracker and the monthly billing data.
* Liaise with GP Finance and the Senior Director on billing, forecasting and commercial matters.

**Service Quality, KPIs & SLA Compliance**

* Set, monitor and control KPIs for the entire team; act on deviations and identify improvement opportunities.
* Define, maintain and monitor service delivery quality standards for the Training Centre, and lead continuous-improvement reviews.
* Receive and review the Training Administrator's reports on the Operating Standards Manual and the adoption of agreed processes across the team, and act on any gaps.
* Submit Deviation Requests to BMW by the 14-day fill-rate measurement date.
* Submit Legitimate Cause claims with supporting evidence within the contractual timelines.
* Direct the Training Administrator's support in preparing Deviation Requests and Legitimate Cause claims.
* Dispute SLA results with evidence within 5 business days of notification.
* Issue Service Rectification Plans and corrective and preventive action plans when Non-Compliance Events occur.
* Hold accountability for the compliance register of vendor agreements, work permits, licences and sub-supplier documents maintained by the Training Administrator.

**Product Launches, Conferences & Events**

* Own all product launches, conferences and events end to end, as decision-maker and custodian of quality, budget, BMW CI and brand standards, approvals and execution, liaising with BMW so that decisions reflect its requirements.
* Review and approve launch event concepts developed by the Training Co-ordinator, together with BMW.
* Lead the briefing for each launch or event, and feed approved concepts and decisions through to the team and external event suppliers.
* Support the team in the operational delivery of launches and events, as briefed.

**Vendor Oversight**

* Approve training vendors and programmes together with BMW and the BMW regional office.
* Produce a briefing document for supplier tender, or for a selected supplier to GP, setting out the programme requirement, key success factors, budget and timing, and appoint the supplier.
* Hold an annual review with each supplier, including written feedback from importers, participants and BMW where possible.

**People & Resource Management**

* Lead the BMW ME team to achieve its KPIs and SLA obligations.
* Manage the performance of direct reports, including objectives, quarterly conversations, reviews and performance improvement plans.
* Manage time sheets and approve leave and sickness for all Training Centre staff, and handle team escalations.
* Act as the escalation point for internal operational matters handled day to day by the Training Co-ordinator.
* Manage grievances and employee issues together with GP Strategies management.
* Manage the performance of employed and vendor trainers against SLA quality and conduct requirements.
* Sit in on training regularly to ensure employed and vendor trainers maintain training standards consistently, and give them feedback.
* Recruit staff, including CV review, interviews and scoring.
* Maintain a recruitment pipeline and back-up resource plan, and fill replacement or additional roles within 3 months.
* Replace trainers within 5 business days when required by BMW, or put interim mitigation in place.
* Support trainer capacity planning and allocation.
* Onboard and certify new or replacement trainers.
* Support trainer calibration, train-the-trainer and professional development.
* Seek opportunities to reward and recognise the team and vendor trainers.

**Ad Hoc Duties**

* Undertake additional duties associated with the successful delivery of the BMW ME training programme, as reasonably required by the Senior Director.

* Course fill-rate of at least 95% (minimum 8 participants where applicable) and delivery of the agreed annual training volume.
* Participant satisfaction of at least 90% per course, per trainer and as a monthly average.
* Complete course content readiness before every delivery.

**Professional Competence**

* People leadership: performance management, recruitment and team development.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; able to interpret training data and KPI reports.
* Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
* High proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Teams.
* Working knowledge of TMSi or another learning management system is advantageous.

**Personal Competence**

* Demonstrates accountability and ownership for results.
* Professional and confident with senior internal and external stakeholders.
* High emotional intelligence and cultural awareness across diverse markets.
* Commercially minded, with strong attention to detail.
* Proactive in identifying issues and opportunities rather than waiting for direction.
* Calm and decisive under pressure; manages competing priorities effectively.
* Builds trust and credibility with the client, the team and vendors.
* Positive, collaborative and solutions-focused.

Title: Senior Manager, Digital Health & Technology (Healthcare Sector Exp) 50013026
Description:
**Job Purpose**
The Senior Manager of Digital Health & Technology leads the definition, prioritisation and delivery readiness of QHC's healthcare digital, data and technology requirements. The role translates clinical, operational and corporate priorities into clear technology requirements, delivery roadmaps, information flows and reporting needs, while coordinating with QIC / QTech on solution design, architecture alignment, implementation planning and service readiness.
  
  
In a healthcare startup, technology is a critical enabler of clinical operations, reporting, integration and patient experience. The role supports prioritization of the systems required across Sports Medicine, Citywide Healthcare and IHN, and tracks technology dependencies, delivery risks and readiness requirements. Specifically, within Sport Medicine / Performance , technology is core infrastructure rather than a support afterthought: electronic health records, clinical and athlete-monitoring platforms, analytics and cybersecurity must be specified, procured, deployed and integrated to enable safe clinical delivery and evidence-based performance health.
  
  
The role works closely with clinical, operations, finance and enabling teams to translate business and clinical needs into healthcare technology and data requirements, coordinating with function owners and QTech to ensure solutions are aligned with healthcare requirements and that data is usable for decision-making. The role also supports technology quality assurance, readiness and compliance with relevant healthcare-specific technology and data requirements.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Digital Health Strategy & Technology Requirements
* Implement approved QHC Digital Blueprint and define QHC's health technology requirements and digital roadmap across clinical, operational and enabling domains, aligned with the organization's startup priorities and target operating model
* Translate clinical and business needs into technology specifications, architecture principles and a prioritized delivery plan
* Advise leadership on build-versus-leverage decisions across the QIC / QTech and partner ecosystem
* Coordinate with QTech and relevant function owners on interoperability and integration requirements across clinical, operational and administrative systems
* Data Management, Analytics & Business Intelligence
* Define QHC's healthcare data requirements, information flows, data ownership and reporting needs across functions
* Define and coordinate analytics and reporting requirements that support data-driven clinical, operational and leadership decision-making
* Track data availability, quality, ownership and reporting gaps, coordinating with function owners to ensure healthcare data is usable for decision-making
* Support reporting and data needs across the organization as capability matures
* QTech / QIC SLA & Vendor Service Delivery
* Define, establish and manage service-level agreements with QIC / QTech and technology partners, ensuring strong, accountable service delivery to QHC
* Monitor vendor and partner performance against SLAs and drive remediation where service falls short
* Act as the primary QHC coordination point with QTech and relevant technology stakeholders on healthcare-specific technology requirements and delivery priorities
* Cybersecurity, Data Privacy & Governance
* In coordination with QIC, embed cybersecurity, data privacy and information-governance controls across all platforms and data flows from the outset
* In coordination with QIC, ensure compliance with Saudi data-protection and healthcare information regulations and applicable international standards
* In coordination with QIC, establish access controls, audit trails and incident-response readiness for health and personal data
* Deployment, Integration & Readiness
* Oversee deployment and integration readiness for all technology, ensuring systems are tested, secure and operational ahead of go-live milestones
* Coordinate healthcare-specific testing and readiness activities with QTech and relevant clinical and operational teams
* Track technology readiness against the enterprise activation roadmap
* Innovation & Digital Enablement
* Identify and introduce digital health innovations — telehealth, remote athlete monitoring, wearables and AI-assisted tools — aligned with partner best practice
* Pilot and scale digital solutions that enhance clinical quality, athlete outcomes and operational efficiency

**Requirements**
**EXPERIENCE & ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Health Informatics, Engineering, or a related field is required. A Master's degree and recognized certifications (e.g. health informatics, cybersecurity, TOGAF, ITIL, or vendor platform certifications
  
  
8+ years of progressive experience in digital health, healthcare IT, health informatics or technology delivery, including experience defining healthcare technology requirements, supporting EHR and healthcare platform delivery, and coordinating technology readiness in new or transforming organizations.
  
  
Demonstrated experience managing technology vendors and SLAs, data management and analytics, and cybersecurity / data-privacy controls within a healthcare environment. Experience within accredited healthcare institutions (JCI, CBAHI) is an advantage.
  
  
Working knowledge of Saudi data-protection and healthcare information regulatory frameworks, and of interoperability and integration across clinical and administrative systems.

Title: Senior Vice President, Global Services
Description:
****Responsibilities****
The
**Senior Vice President, Global Services**
owns the end-to-end delivery of Octave implementation, deployment, and migration services worldwide. Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer, this role is accountable for the global portfolio of customer programs, from initial deployments to enterprise cloud consolidations and legacy migrations.
  
  
This role makes services a growth engine, not just a delivery function. You will lead regional delivery, project management, deployment engineering, solution architecture, training, and cutover teams across Americas, EMIA, and APAC while building one global delivery system. The outcome is shorter time-to-value, repeatable deployments, productized services, improved margin and predictability, and greater go-live confidence.
  
  
**Transform and Accelerate Global Services Execution**

* Build one global delivery system. Replace regional variation with a consistent global methodology for project governance, portfolio health, forecasting, risk, and escalation management.
* Stand up a global PMO and center of excellence. Create global delivery and technical implementation capabilities with flexible resourcing and follow-the-sun coverage.
* Shift the operating culture. Move from bespoke customer requirements toward a software-implementation mindset: configure rather than customize, and address product gaps through the roadmap rather than services hours.
* Align services to the revenue motion. Connect Services with Sales, Channel, and Customer Success through services attach, migration offers, clean handoffs, and consistent scoping and estimating.
* Hire, train, and shift talent globally. Bring in modern SaaS delivery expertise, re-skill tenured talent, develop regional successors, and reshape roles for the future operating model.
* Tighten the R&D-to-Services loop. Turn implementation friction into prioritized roadmap input and roadmap delivery into faster, cleaner, more repeatable deployments.

****What You'll Own****

* Global services P&L, utilization and portfolio performance. Own worldwide services revenue, margin, utilization, backlog, forecasting, services attach, conversion, and on-time/on-budget delivery.
* Mission-critical go-lives, worldwide. Own global playbooks, governance, escalation paths, follow-the-sun support, and executive intervention for at-risk deployments.
* Global cloud migration program. Lead migration of Octave's installed base to the cloud, including commercial offers, technical execution, customer change management, data residency, and migration tooling.
* Services transformation. Move from bespoke work toward productized offerings for deployments, cloud transitions, consolidations, and AI enablement, supported by reusable accelerators and reference architectures.
* Partner and delivery ecosystem. Expand and govern the global SI and reseller network with consistent certification, quality standards, and joint-delivery models.
* Regulatory and compliance-aware delivery. Meet applicable security, GDPR, data-sovereignty, and country-specific requirements without fragmenting the global operating model.
* Customer outcomes. Partner with Customer Success, Support, and Product to improve time-to-value, post-go-live stabilization, and customer reference-ability.
* Team. Lead and develop a global organization spanning delivery, program management, architecture, engineering, migration, training, and field readiness, with 1,000+ FTEs plus contractor, nearshore/offshore, and partner capacity.

****Education / Qualifications****

* A senior global services executive with 20+ years of enterprise software delivery experience, including at least 8 years leading services organizations at VP/SVP scale and direct accountability for a $100M+ multi-region services P&L. You have led services teams across at least two of the three major regions (Americas, EMEA, APAC) and understand what it takes to run one global operating model across different labor markets, procurement cultures, and regulatory environments.
* You've done this in a mission-critical, regulated, or 24/7-operations software category — public safety, healthcare, utilities, manufacturing quality, industrial asset management, financial services trading systems, air traffic, defense — somewhere downtime is not an option and customers are operationally dependent on your software the moment it goes live.
* You've led a services transformation at global scale, not just managed delivery. You've taken a custom-project organization and moved it meaningfully toward productized, repeatable, partner-leveraged delivery across multiple regions, and you can speak to the specific levers you pulled and the numbers that moved.
* You've owned a cloud migration program at scale — moving an installed base of on-prem customers to SaaS or managed cloud across multiple countries — and you understand the commercial, technical, change-management, and data-sovereignty mechanics of doing that without breaking customer trust.
* You know how to operate inside a revenue organization. You've partnered tightly with Sales and Channel on attach, packaging, and pricing of services; you treat the forecast as a shared commitment; and you can hold the line on delivery quality and margin while still moving at the speed the revenue engine demands.
* You lead in the field, globally. Customers on every continent expect to meet the executive who is accountable for their deployment. You're comfortable on-site at 2 a.m. during a cutover, in an executive briefing the next week, and in a board review the week after — and you build regional leaders who can carry that presence when you're not in the room.
* You make decisions with incomplete information, hold a clear line on quality and commitments across time zones and cultures, and have a track record of building global organizations people want to stay at.

**Nice to Have**

* Direct experience delivering mission-critical operational software (dispatch, quality management, EAM/APM, or comparable categories)
* Background as a customer-side operations or technology executive who later moved vendor-side
* Experience with Hexagon-heritage platforms or comparable enterprise software ecosystems
* Experience integrating an AI-assisted offering into an established services motion
* Experience operating in-country delivery entities, works-council environments, and public-sector or regulated-industry procurement outside North America

Our products sit at the heart of our customers' operations: when they go live, downtime is not an option, and customers are operationally dependent on our software from day one.
  
  
Following Octave's spin-off from Hexagon, we are accelerating a global shift to cloud-delivered, AI-enabled solutions. Power Factors is a software and solutions provider leading the next generation of clean energy with Unity, one of the most extensive and widely deployed renewable energy management suites (REMS) in the market. With over 300 GW of wind, solar, and energy storage assets managed worldwide across more than 600 customers and 18,000 sites, Power Factors manages 25% of the world’s renewable energy data.\*

Power Factors’ Unity REMS supports the entire energy value chain, from monitoring and controls to market analytics. The company’s suite of open, data-driven applications empowers renewable energy stakeholders to collaborate, automate critical workflows, and make more informed decisions to maximize asset returns. Energy stakeholders receive end-to-end support, including solutions for SCADA & PPC, centralized monitoring, performance management, commercial asset management, and field service management.

With deep domain expertise, AI-powered insights are delivered at scale so businesses can optimize assets, unlock growth, and make smarter decisions as the world rapidly transitions to clean energy. Power Factors fights climate change with code.

* Outside China and India

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Power Factors is scaling in complexity — more products, more platforms, more sophisticated buyers, and rapidly rising expectations for AI-native capability across our renewable energy software suite. In that context, the absence of a single, accountable technical vision creates real risk: divergent architectural patterns across verticals, inconsistent approaches to AI and data platform investment, and technical debt that compounds faster than it can be paid down.

The Head of Software Architecture exists to close that gap. This is a hands-on, deeply technical leadership role responsible for defining and enforcing enterprise architecture standards across Power Factors' Product & Technology organization — spanning Platform, SCADA, EMS, APM, CloudOps, and CAM/FSM/Product Ops — while personally architecting and prototyping the hardest problems the organization faces, particularly around AI-based product introductions, IoT data acquisition, and multi-tenant SaaS scalability.

This role combines the strategic scope of an enterprise architect with the credibility of a builder who still writes code, reviews pull requests, and is comfortable being the most technical person in the room.

### **Purpose of the Role**

The Head of Software Architecture acts to define, evangelize, and enforce a coherent technical architecture strategy that allows Power Factors to scale product complexity without sacrificing reliability, security, or development velocity.

* **Enterprise-wide architectural coherence:** Technical decisions across verticals are grounded in shared architectural principles, not siloed team preferences.
* **AI-native product development:** New AI-based product capabilities are architected end-to-end — from data pipeline to model integration to user-facing experience — rather than bolted on.
* **Development velocity multiplication:** Engineering teams are equipped with modern AI-assisted development tooling and workflows that materially increase throughput.
* **Deep technical credibility:** Engineering leaders and individual contributors alike see this role as a working architect, not a slide-deck strategist.
* **Domain-informed design:** Architecture decisions reflect genuine understanding of renewable energy operations — SCADA, EMS, PPC, edge devices, and grid-facing data systems.

This role acts as the connective tissue between the CPTO's organizational strategy and the day-to-day technical decisions made by vertical engineering teams.

### **Core Responsibilities**

### **1. Enterprise Architecture & Complex System Design**

* Define and maintain Power Factors' enterprise architecture standards, reference architectures, and technical guardrails across all verticals
* Lead architectural reviews for major initiatives, ensuring consistency, scalability, and long-term maintainability
* Own the technical roadmap for cross-cutting platform capabilities (data platform, integration layer, identity, observability)
* Design for complex, high-availability systems where correctness, latency, and data integrity carry real operational and commercial consequences
* Partner with vertical leaders (SCADA, EMS, APM, Platform, CloudOps) to ensure local architecture decisions align with enterprise direction

### **2. Technical Team Leadership**

* Build and lead a distributed architecture function that operates as a trusted technical authority across Greece, Montreal, and other regions
* Mentor senior engineers and engineering leaders on architectural judgment, system design, and technical tradeoff analysis
* Establish and run architecture governance forums (design reviews, RFC processes, technical steering committees)
* Act as a technical escalation point for the highest-stakes design decisions across the organization

### **3. AI-Based Product Architecture & Delivery**

* Architect and personally help build end-to-end AI-based product capabilities — from data acquisition and model selection through deployment and monitoring
* Define Power Factors' architectural approach to LLM-based products, including use of Model Context Protocol (MCP), retrieval architectures, and agentic workflows
* Evaluate and select development LLMs and AI platforms appropriate for embedding into commercial products
* Own the technical bridge between REMI and other AI-native initiatives and the broader platform architecture
* Bring machine learning and data science expertise to bear on product decisions — model selection, feature engineering, data pipeline design, and MLOps practices

### **4. Hands-On Development**

* Write production code, prototype new architectural patterns, and directly contribute to the hardest technical problems facing the organization
* Lead by example on code quality, testing discipline, and engineering craftsmanship
* Stay close enough to the codebase to make credible, current architectural judgments rather than relying on secondhand reporting
* Build proof-of-concept implementations to de-risk major architectural bets before full team investment

### **5. IoT, Edge, and Industrial Systems Architecture**

* Architect scalable IoT data acquisition systems capable of ingesting, normalizing, and processing high-volume telemetry from distributed renewable energy assets
* Design architecture for edge devices and Power Plant Controllers (PPC), balancing on-site computation, latency constraints, and cloud connectivity
* Ensure architectural approaches account for grid code compliance, real-time control requirements, and the operational realities of SCADA and EMS environments
* Apply renewables and energy industry domain knowledge to inform data model, integration, and control system design decisions

### **6. Cloud, SaaS, and Multi-Tenant Architecture**

* Own cloud architecture strategy across GCP and/or AWS, including cost, resilience, and security posture
* Advance Power Factors' multi-tenant SaaS architecture to support scale, tenant isolation, and configurability without fragmenting the codebase
* Define architectural standards for mobile app development where products extend to field and operations use cases
* Evaluate build-vs-buy and platform consolidation decisions across the technology stack

### **7. Engineering Productivity & AI-Enabled Development**

* Identify, evaluate, and roll out AI development tools that enable a 3–4x productivity improvement across engineering teams
* Define best practices for AI-assisted coding, testing, and code review, balancing speed with quality and security
* Partner with engineering leadership to measure and report on productivity gains from AI tooling adoption

### **Reporting & Operating Model**

### **Reporting Line**

* Reports to: Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO)

Embedded collaboration with:

* Vertical engineering leaders (Platform, SCADA, EMS, APM, CloudOps, CAM/FSM/Product Ops)
* Product Management and Product Marketing on AI-based product introductions
* CloudOps and Security on infrastructure and compliance posture

### **Operating Principles**

* Architecture in service of the business, not architecture for its own sake
* Hands-on credibility over theoretical authority
* Pragmatic standardization — enough consistency to scale, not so much it stifles teams
* AI-first thinking applied responsibly, with attention to data quality, safety, and reliability

### **Skills & Profile**

### **Required Experience**

* **15–20 years** of progressive experience in software engineering, with significant time spent in architecture and technical leadership roles
* **Enterprise Architecture & Complex System Design:** demonstrated experience architecting large-scale, high-complexity systems with significant operational stakes
* **Technical Team Leadership:** proven ability to lead and mentor senior engineers and architects across distributed teams
* **Trading/Transactional Systems:** experience building high-throughput, high-integrity trading or transactional systems where correctness and performance are non-negotiable
* **AI Product Delivery:** track record architecting and shipping end-to-end AI-based product introductions, from concept to production launch
* **Hands-On Development:** an architect who still codes — genuinely enjoys building, not just designing
* **IoT Data Acquisition:** experience with systems that ingest and process high-volume telemetry from distributed physical assets
* **Edge Devices & Power Plant Controllers (PPC):** familiarity with edge computing architectures and industrial control systems
* **Renewables / Energy Industry Experience:** ideally direct experience in renewable energy or broader energy sector software (strongly preferred, not required)
* **Machine Learning & Data Science:** solid working knowledge sufficient to make informed architectural and platform decisions
* **MCP & LLM-Based Products:** hands-on experience with Model Context Protocol, development LLMs, and building LLM-based product features
* **Cloud Platforms:** deep experience with GCP and/or AWS at an architectural level
* **AI Development Tooling:** experience selecting and rolling out AI dev tools that meaningfully increase engineering team productivity
* **SaaS & Multi-Tenant Architecture:** advanced experience designing and scaling multi-tenant SaaS applications
* **Mobile App Development:** working knowledge of mobile architecture and delivery, sufficient to guide teams building mobile experiences

### **Core Capabilities**

* Strong systems thinking with the ability to zoom between enterprise strategy and line-level code
* Executive-level communication — able to translate architectural tradeoffs into business terms for the CPTO and executive team
* Comfortable operating with significant technical authority while remaining collaborative and low-ego
* Genuine enthusiasm for staying current with the fast-moving AI and LLM landscape

### **Background Fit**

* Principal Engineer, Distinguished Engineer, VP of Engineering, or Chief Architect background
* Experience operating in a scaling, multi-product SaaS organization
* Comfortable being both the enterprise architecture authority and an individual contributor when the problem demands it

### **Success Metrics (KPIs)**

* Number of AI-based product capabilities architected and shipped to production per year
* Measured productivity gains (velocity, cycle time) attributable to AI development tooling rollout
* Reduction in cross-vertical architectural inconsistency and duplicated platform investment
* System reliability and performance metrics for enterprise-critical and transactional systems
* Adoption rate of architectural standards and reference designs across engineering teams
* Qualitative 360° feedback from engineering leaders on technical leadership effectiveness

### **What This Role Is Not**

This role is not a purely strategic or advisory position removed from the codebase, and it is not a people-management role focused primarily on process and reporting. The Head of Software Architecture is expected to remain a credible, hands-on technical contributor throughout their tenure.

The role also does not own product roadmap prioritization or commercial strategy — those remain with Product Management and the CPTO — but it directly shapes what is technically possible and how quickly it can be delivered.

Clinicians, schools, and hospitals rely on WPS assessments to evaluate autism, learning differences, and developmental needs. * Design, hire, and develop the engineering organization — including managers, QA, and the leadership layers needed to scale — with clear ownership, decision rights, and career paths.
* Lead the transition from external development partners to internal and nearshore teams, ensuring continuity of delivery, knowledge transfer, and shared ownership of the codebase.

* Establish automated feedback loops that turn lessons from shipped features, bug fixes, code reviews, and customer outcomes into better context, agent instructions, and tests.
* Define engineering metrics for delivery speed, quality, and reliability, and set standards for AI tool use, validation, and human oversight.
* Own the software development lifecycle from intake through production support, partnering with Product Management on roadmap and priorities.
* Set standards for CI/CD, testing, observability, privacy, accessibility, and secure development, in partnership with Infrastructure and Security & Compliance.

* Experience shipping production software in a high-accuracy, high-trust, or regulated environment, and modernizing an existing platform while continuing to ship.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred), modern CI/CD, and automated testing.
* A people leadership track record that former direct reports will vouch for, including building performance management and career development.

**Preferred**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 2+ years in a high-rigor engineering environment, such as a fast-scaling technology company.
* Experience in healthcare, education, assessment, publishing, or other expert-content domains.

**Organization Building:** Designs, hires, and develops engineering teams and leaders; adds structure and management layers as the organization scales.

**AI-First Engineering:** Builds shared AI workflows and standards that measurably improve delivery speed, quality, and reliability.

Title: Vertical Operations Director
Description:
**🚀 Welcome to Your Next Adventure!**
The Vertical Operations Director is responsible for owning and scaling the operational performance of Snoonu’s key business verticals, including grocery, laundry, ticketing, and any future verticals launched under Snoonu’s ecosystem.
  
  
This role ensures that each vertical operates with clear ownership, strong execution, high service quality, and profitable growth, while maintaining Snoonu’s customer obsession and operational standards.

Own the operational performance of grocery, supermarket, convenience, and quick-commerce partners.

Own the operational performance of laundry partners and end-to-end laundry order flow.

* Build quality control standards for laundry partners.

* Improve customer trust in the laundry vertical through reliability, transparency, and service recovery.

Own the operational execution of ticketing services, events, bookings, and related customer experiences.
  
  

* Ensure ticket inventory, availability, pricing, and event details are accurate.
* Coordinate with event organizers, venues, partners, product, finance, and customer support.
* Manage operational readiness before, during, and after major events.
* Reduce customer issues related to ticket access, QR codes, refunds, cancellations, and event changes.
* Create clear SOPs for event-day support and escalation.
* Ensure smooth settlement and reporting with ticketing partners.
* Support major event launches with risk assessment and operational planning.
* Build scalable ticketing processes for future expansion into entertainment, experiences, sports, and tourism.

For flowers, pharmacies, electronics, beauty, gifts, fashion, and general retail partners.
  
  

* Improving item accuracy, merchant readiness, fulfillment time, packaging, and delivery handover.
* Reducing cancellations, unavailable items, wrong items, and poor packaging complaints.
* Building SOPs for sensitive categories such as pharmacy, flowers, electronics, and gifts.
* Supporting category-specific service standards.
* Marketplace Operations

Own the overall marketplace health across multiple verticals.
  
  

* Monitor supply availability across merchants and categories.
* Ensure strong coordination between merchant operations, logistics, product, and customer support.
* Improve operational KPIs across all marketplace verticals.
* Identify marketplace gaps such as low availability, weak fulfillment, poor merchant compliance, or high complaint rates.
* Support new vertical launches with proper operating models and readiness checks.

Lead operational readiness for new Snoonu verticals before launch.
  
  

* Define the operating model for each new vertical.
* Build SOPs, SLAs, partner requirements, customer support flows, and escalation rules.
* Run pilot launches before scaling.
* Identify operational risks before public launch.
* Work with product to ensure the customer journey is ready.
* Work with finance to validate pricing, commission, refunds, and settlement processes.
* Ensure logistics capacity and delivery requirements are clear.

**Job Summary**
---------------

As a Senior Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will work with Enable’s (including Flintfox) largest and most complex customers to drive strategic growth across complex enterprise environments. This role requires building multi-threaded executive relationships, leading global account strategy, and elevating customers into long-term strategic partnerships by delivering value through positive business outcomes.  
  
You will own and execute the success strategy for your focused portfolio. You will champion strategic account planning excellence, joint executive sponsorship, thought leadership engagement, cross-functional orchestration, and a relentless focus on client success and value delivery.

This is a highly visible role, responsible for building trusted executive relationships, and developing Enable’s largest customers into long-term strategic partners. You will work across Enable to help customers realize measurable value, strengthen retention, and identify opportunities for sustainable account growth.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**
--------------------------------

#### **Global Account & Customer Success Leadership**

* Serve as the Global Organizational Client Touch Point, owning executive alignment across regions and business units.
* Build deep, trusted relationships with C-level executives, stakeholders and economic buyers, and be trusted as your customers’ strategic advisor to ensure retention and secure expansions.
* Establish and maintain joint executive sponsorship programs to elevate Enable from vendor to strategic partner.
* Develop champions and strengthen influence across the power structure within each account.
* Continuously learn and upskill yourself to become a rebate and pricing industry expert your customers can rely upon for best practices.

  

#### **Strategic Account Planning & Command Center Execution**

* Lead comprehensive, multi-threaded account plans incorporating champion mapping, whitespace analysis, opportunity strategy, and executive cadence.
* Maintain accurate customer records, renewal and expansion forecasts in customer success platforms including Hook, Salesforce, and Clari.
* Execute disciplined MEDDPICC qualification and Force Management methodology.
* Develop Lighthouse customers into strategic advocates that strengthen Enable’s market and category position.
* Develop and execute account strategies that support product adoption, retention, renewal and expansion.
* Monitor and communicate measurable value realization and platform adoption to both external clients and internal stakeholders. Directly maintain and, where required, drive product adoption and value for post-implementation stage customers.

  

#### **Retention & Expansion Growth**

* Consistently exceed GRR and NRR quota through retention and expansion of existing clients.
* Partner with the Sales team to identify and convert Customer Success Qualified Leads (CSQLs) into expansion opportunities.
* Drive whitespace penetration and multi-entity expansion within global enterprises.
* Drive Customer Loyalty and Satisfaction by proactively seeking out advocacy opportunities and managing the NPS and CSAT metrics for your assigned customers.
* Identify expansion opportunities, upsell, and renewal by understanding customer needs and aligning them with our product roadmap.
* Identify at-risk accounts early and develop strategies to mitigate churn.

  

#### **Global Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Foster collaboration across Sales, Solutions Consulting, Customer Success, Enterprise Services, Architects, COE, Product Management, and Marketing to gather feedback and advocate for client needs and strategic priorities.
* Mobilize executive sponsors, thought leaders, and cross-functional experts to bring the full value of Enable to Lighthouse customers.
* Deliver a white-glove customer experience through proactive, personalized engagement and seamless cross-functional coordination for high-value strategic customers.

  

#### **Executive Presence & Strategic Influence**

* Demonstrate strong executive presence in board-level and C-suite conversations.
* Articulate business value, ROI, risk mitigation, operational efficiency, and strategic agility.
* Lead executive exchanges grounded in trust, open communication, and mutual value creation.

Title: Service Desk Team Lead
Description:
**Job Summary**

The Service Desk Team Lead owns the day-to-day performance of the Service Desk and client satisfaction. You will lead a team of Level 1 and Level 2 helpdesk engineers, act as the team's technical escalation point, manage the team's workload so tickets are handled on time and to a high standard, and provide clear reporting on service desk health to the Vice President of Service Delivery.

**Duties**

* Lead, coach and develop a team of helpdesk engineers, including regular one-on-ones, performance feedback and onboarding of new team members
* Handle day-to-day people management: take part in hiring and interviews, run weekly team meetings, complete performance reviews, approve time off and plan shift coverage
* Manage the team's workload: monitor queues, assign and balance tickets, prioritize by urgency and impact, and plan coverage and schedules
* Make sure tickets meet SLA targets and quality standards, and step in on escalations and at-risk tickets
* Own escalation paths between Level 1, Level 2 and other Conpute teams, and make sure handoffs are clean
* Own and report on service desk KPIs, including SLA compliance, first response time, time to resolution, first contact resolution, ticket backlog, escalation rate, ticket reopen rate and customer satisfaction (CSAT)
* Produce regular reporting for the Sr. Director, including ticket volume, workload by engineer and recurring issues
* Use reporting and KPIs to identify trends, root causes and capacity needs, guide coaching and staffing decisions, and recommend improvements to the Sr. Director
* Own service desk documentation in IT Glue: keep SOPs, runbooks and escalation procedures accurate and current, and make sure engineers document their work
* Maintain and improve service desk processes and ticket quality
* Run the service desk day to day in Autotask and N-able RMM, including queues, tickets, SLAs and client alerts
* Act as the technical escalation point for the Service Desk, resolving complex issues that Level 1 and Level 2 engineers cannot, and as the point of contact for escalations from clients and internal teams
* Work with Account Management, Projects, and AI and Development to improve service delivery

**Qualifications**

* Experience working in a managed service provider (MSP) environment
* Previous management experience
* Direct experience managing a team of helpdesk engineers
* Demonstrated ability to manage team workload, queues and SLAs
* Experience tracking and reporting service desk KPIs and presenting results to senior leadership
* Hands-on experience with an MSP PSA, RMM and documentation platform
* Strong documentation habits, with experience maintaining SOPs, runbooks and knowledge base articles
* Strong hands-on technical skills across Microsoft 365, Windows, networking and common end-user and small business IT support, with a proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues and serve as the technical escalation point for a support team
* Clear written and verbal communication with clients and staff

**Preferred qualifications**

* Direct experience with Autotask, IT Glue and N-able RMM
* ITIL or similar service management training
* Microsoft certifications

Reporting to the Senior Director of Customer Success and Innovation at CPS, the Director, Central Assist Operations is responsible for the strategic leadership, operational performance, and national oversight of multiple Central Assist teams within Central Pharmacy Services (CPS). The role provides end-to-end accountability for the delivery of centralized, non-production and cognitive pharmacy services, ensuring operational excellence, financial performance, regulatory compliance, and a consistent, high-quality experience for pharmacies and patients. As a key member of the CPS leadership team, the Director drives operational strategy, builds scalable processes, and ensures service quality and performance standards are maintained as programs grow nationally.

Nature and Scope

The position requires a high degree of independent decision-making, financial accountability, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to manage complex operations in a rapidly expanding business environment.
* The Director is responsible for translating CPS strategic priorities into operational plans, optimizing resource utilization, developing high-performing leadership teams, and ensuring sustainable business performance.

* Identify financial and operational risks and implement mitigation strategies to ensure commitments are achieved.

**3. Program Expansion & Operational Scalability**

* Ensure expansion initiatives are delivered while maintaining established quality, productivity, and service standards.
* Identify opportunities to expand centralized pharmacy services and increase value delivered to pharmacies, patients, and the organization.

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on service quality, workflow optimization, productivity, and customer experience.
* Leverage operational data, performance metrics, and quality indicators to identify opportunities and drive strategic improvements.
* Establish appropriate risk management and escalation processes to proactively address operational challenges.

Title: Global Head of Revenue & Partnerships
Description:
**About Global Citizen**

Global Citizen is a movement of engaged citizens who are using their collective voice to end extreme poverty. On our platform, Global Citizens learn about the systemic causes of extreme poverty, take action on these issues, and earn rewards for their actions as part of a global community committed to lasting change. Global Citizens have taken over 42.9 million actions since 2009. Today, these actions, in combination with high-level advocacy work, have led to over $49 billion being distributed to our partners around the world, impacting 1.3 billion lives in the fight to end extreme poverty.

**Role Overview**

Global Citizen is hiring a Senior Vice President, Revenue & Partnerships to lead global partnership revenue strategy, oversee the Business Development and Partnerships teams, and secure major new partnerships. Reporting to the CEO, the SVP will be accountable for revenue performance, expansion into priority markets and the long-term growth of the partnership portfolio. The role combines a record of closing large, complex partnership deals, with experience leading teams, and deep experience in at least one of our focus regions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Partnership Development and Revenue (40%)**

* Own global partnership revenue targets and forecasting, alongside a personal new-business target of $5M or more per year.
* Lead the pursuit, negotiation and closure of multi-million dollar partnerships with corporates, governments, foundations, multilaterals, philanthropists and other funders, personally leading priority deals.
* Oversee the global partnership pipeline, setting priorities across markets and partner sectors and reporting revenue forecasts, risks and opportunities to the CEO and executive team.
* Oversee the transition from partnership development to delivery, ensuring continuity in partner relationships and retaining executive accountability for portfolio growth and retention.

**Global Strategy and Market Expansion (20%)**

* Develop and execute the global partnership and growth strategy, in line with the five-year plan, setting priorities across established and emerging markets.
* Work with the CEO to assess and prioritize market expansion, recommend entry approaches and secure partnerships that support growth in priority regions.
* Work with Programs, Policy, Live Events and Product leaders to align partnership growth with organizational plans, delivery capacity and financial requirements.
* Guide regional growth plans with local teams, ensuring partnership approaches reflect local campaigns, fundraising opportunities, media environments and cultural context.

**Senior Relationships and Representation (20%)**

* Build and maintain senior relationships with corporate leaders, philanthropists, foundations and multilateral organizations across priority markets, using these relationships to originate and advance major partnerships.
* Represent Global Citizen in senior partner discussions, negotiations and key international forums, working with the CEO on relationships requiring executive engagement.
* Work with regional leaders and teams to turn relationships into deals and shape partnership opportunities that meet local needs and support global revenue priorities.

**Function and Leadership (20%)**

* Lead the Business Development and Partnerships function, setting team structure, priorities and performance expectations and developing its senior leaders.
* Set annual revenue goals, budgets and resource plans with the CEO and Finance, holding team leaders accountable for new business, retention and delivery performance.
* Work with senior leaders across Policy and Advocacy, Operations, Marketing and Growth, and Talent to align partnership priorities, resolve competing demands and ensure commitments are achievable.
* Contribute to decisions on organizational strategy, investment priorities and growth, bringing insight into revenue opportunities, partner needs and market conditions.

  

**Fundamental Requirements**

*Education & Experience*

* 15 years of experience in business development & global corporate partnerships
* Significant progressive experience in business development and partnerships, including senior leadership accountability for revenue strategy, team performance and major partner relationships.
* A track record of closing multi-million-dollar partnership or sponsorship deals, ideally across more than one partner type, and delivering revenue growth against ambitious targets.
* Deep, current experience in one or more of our focus regions: Latin America (Brazil in particular), Sub-Saharan Africa, Asia or the Middle East. Existing networks in the region are a strong advantage.
* Senior-level credibility with corporate, government, and philanthropic decision-makers, including experience leading complex negotiations and securing executive-level commitments.
* Experience building revenue pipelines in new markets, leading geographically distributed teams and aligning colleagues across functions.
* Experience leading senior managers, setting function-wide budgets and revenue forecasts, and presenting performance and growth recommendations to executive leadership.

*Attributes*

  

* Commercial judgment to assess opportunities, balance revenue potential with delivery costs and risks, and prioritize investment.
* Fluency in a language relevant to a priority market (for example, Portuguese for Brazil) is a plus.
* Ability to develop senior leaders and establish clear accountability across business development and partnership management.
* Ability to thrive in a high-velocity, impact-oriented environment.
* Using AI tools to work smarter and drive impact is an essential part of every role at Global Citizen. All staff must integrate AI into their daily work, whether improving workflows, analyzing information, or enhancing communication in service of our mission.

  

Global Citizen is a fast-moving, mission-driven organization where bold ideas, smart risks, and decisive action are part of how we create impact. We are looking for people who are energized by ambitious goals, comfortable navigating change, and ready to work collaboratively across teams, time zones, and sectors. The pace is high and the work is meaningful, making this a strong fit for people who bring initiative, adaptability, courage, and a deep commitment to driving real-world change.

**Benefits**

**Why Global Citizen?**

In this coming decade of action and accountability, Global Citizen will be the leading international voice, educator, and influencer that rallies humanity to take full responsibility and accountability for eradicating extreme poverty. You have a chance to contribute and make this world a better place for all.

**More Details**

* Must be authorized for employment in the United States.
* Global Citizen operates on a hybrid work model - 3 days (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday) in our NYC office and 2 days (Monday & Friday) telecommuting.
* This position is based in New York City and requires domestic and international travel of up to 30% to support strategic partnerships, stakeholder engagement, and organizational priorities.
* Full-time, ongoing employees are eligible for a competitive benefits package: Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance; commuter benefits; 403(b) retirement savings & employer match; generous paid time off (vacation, sick, and holidays); paid parental leave; employee discounts; FSA; Professional Development Assistance (EAP).
* Salary Range: $225,000 - $250,000. This role is bonus-eligible.

Global Citizen strictly prohibits and does not tolerate discrimination against employees, applicants, or any other covered persons because of race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, citizenship or any other protected classification under applicable federal, state, or local laws. In addition, Global Citizen complies with the relevant country laws governing employment nondiscrimination in all our international offices. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.*
